node.n1_safehouse.title: Indlu Yekucasha (Room 404)
node.n1_safehouse.desc: Lifulethi lelisemgangaweni wesitsatfu, ngaphezu kwendzawo yekuhlanza tingubo leisebenta ema-awara langu-24. Kukhanya kweneon lokucimako, emaphepha emacala, kanye nejeneretha yesimo lesiphuthumako.
node.n2_taxi_rank.title: Queen Street Taxi Rank
node.n2_taxi_rank.desc: Indzawo lekhulu yetimoto leti-Toyota Quantum letimile, emajeneretha labhodlako, kanye nephunga le-shisanyama leyosiwe.
node.n3_central_precinct.title: Durban Central Police Station
node.n3_central_precinct.desc: Imihubhe legcwele emalambu lachachamako, emajele lakhiyiwe, kanye nendzawo yekuyala ye-TRT ya-Brigadier Mokoena.
node.n4_city_hall.title: City Hall Tender Office
node.n4_city_hall.desc: Tinsika temabula letifihla imihlangano yaphansi, tinkontileka temphepha, kanye nemibhalo yethenda lephukile.
node.n5_cyber_pawn.title: Point Road Cyber-Pawn
node.n5_cyber_pawn.desc: Likhawuntara lekhanyiswe ngeneon ledayisa ema-SIM khadi lamacala, emarediyo emphi, kanye netinsimbi letingalandzeleki.
node.n6_pier2_port.title: Pier 2 Container Terminal
node.n6_pier2_port.desc: Omakhenikha labakhulu labaphakeme enkungwini yelwandle. Berth 14 iphetse imikhumbi yemakhemikhali leingabhaliswanga.
node.n7_archive_basement.title: Old Municipal Archive Basement
node.n7_archive_basement.desc: Emakamu langaphansi kwemhlaba lagcwele emanti, lapho kugcinwe khona iminyaka leminyenti yemibhalo yamasipala kanye nemininingwane leputile ye-Hawks.
node.n8_ridge_penthouses.title: The Ridge Penthouses
node.n8_ridge_penthouses.desc: Tindlu letiphakeme letakhiwe ngengilazi nensimbi letibuka lwandle i-Indian Ocean. Tilindwe ngemabutfo ekulwa langasese lanema-akhawunti angaphandle.
node.n9_township_depot.title: Northern Township Depot
node.n9_township_depot.desc: Tindlu letinkhulu letakhiwe ngensimbi lephahliwe, letigcwele emaloli emanti latsinjiwe, kusebentisa emandla kagesi ngendlela lengekho emthethweni, kanye nebantfu labahlomile labalindile.
node.n10_high_court.title: Durban High Court Chambers
node.n10_high_court.desc: Inkantolo lenemigangatho yensimbi nenkuni lapho kucociswana khona ngetimfuno temthetho letimelene nemacembu ebugebengu.
node.n11_citrus_estate.title: Hydroponic Citrus Estate
node.n11_citrus_estate.desc: Indzawo lecinisiwe lelifihla emareyaktha emakhemikhali langaphansi kwemhlaba kanye netindzawo tekugcina tintfo letibalulekile.
node.n12_cargo_apron.title: King Shaka Cargo Apron
node.n12_cargo_apron.desc: Hangar 7 lapho emajethi e-Gulfstream ZS-900 kanye nemaloli lamakhulu adlula khona ngaphandle kwemvume yaseNingizimu Afrika.

msg.nightfall_summary: Kushona kwelilanga kutawutsintsa emaclock etinsita futsi kushintje titeji te-Eskom Load Shedding.
msg.next_day_forecast: Tidayisi tangemuso tibhalwa ngekusho kwe-Composure yakho.
slot.act_audit_docket.title: Hlola Docket #409
slot.act_audit_docket.desc: Cwaninga ti-invoice temathangi letineligazi uziqhathanise neluhlu lomasipala.
slot.act_audit_docket.clean: Ulandzelela timali ngco ku-Zululand Aqua-Logistics nase-Pier 2.
slot.act_audit_docket.compromised: Emaviki ekucwaninga ngaphansi kwesibani lesicwayizako kukulethela ligama le-shell director linye.
slot.act_audit_docket.failure: Emakhodi elijara ayindida lengenakuphuma kuyo. Inhloko yakho iyashaya.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.title: Phumula Uphindze Ulungise Nandi
slot.act_rest_safehouse.desc: Buyisela emandla. Tsenga imithi yekubopha inyongo kuze ulibambise liviki lesilalo saNandi.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.clean: Uhlanteka emabhandeshi akhe bese uyaphumula. Umkhuhlane waNandi uyehla kancane.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.compromised: Kuphumula kuphazanyiswa timphondvo temaphoyisa letivela e-Queen Street.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.failure: Kulala lokungaphumuli lokugcwele emaphupho amabi mayelana nemasotja e-TRT yaMokoena.
slot.act_call_maharaj.title: Shayela Dr. Maharaj (Dokotela longasemtsetfweni)
slot.act_call_maharaj.desc: Leta dokotela wetimphilo lotimele kutsi akhiphe inhlamvu futsi alungise Nandi.
slot.act_call_maharaj.clean: Dr. Maharaj ukhipha inhlamvu ngaphandle kwenkinga. Nandi akasasezingeni lelibi.
slot.act_call_maharaj.compromised: Kuhlinza kunzima ngaphansi kwesibani, kodvwa Nandi uyatfola emandla.
slot.act_call_maharaj.failure: Dr. Maharaj wetfuka ngemoto yemaphoyisa langaphandle bese ushiya imithi yema-antibiotics kuphela.
slot.act_rank_muscle.title: Phocelela Timali Temgwaqo
slot.act_rank_muscle.desc: Cindzetela bashayeli labangakabhaliswa emgwaqweni wase-Umgeni kuze kuzuze Bra Bheki.
slot.act_rank_muscle.clean: Bashayeli labangakabhaliswa bayakhokha ngaphandle kwekukhipha tibhamu. Bra Bheki uyavuma ngekuhlonipha.
slot.act_rank_muscle.compromised: Umtshina ukushaya ehlombe ekulweni, kodvwa uhamba nemali.
slot.act_rank_muscle.failure: Kudutjulwa eduze kwesiteshi. Timphondvo temaphoyisa a-Metro tiyakhala kuleyo ndzawo.
slot.act_taxi_intel.title: Sebentisa Inethiwekhi Yebashayeli
slot.act_taxi_intel.desc: Khokhela bomarshal kutsi balandzele emabakkie e-TRT langabhalwanga kanye netindzawo tekumisa.
slot.act_taxi_intel.clean: Bashayeli beteteksi bagcwalisa imisakato ngemigwaco lecondzile yaMokoena.
slot.act_taxi_intel.compromised: Lwati loluhlakatekile kubashayeli lababone ingxenye nje yeluhlu lwemoto.
slot.act_taxi_intel.failure: Ukhokhela lwati lolungasizi ngalutfo, nje ngemahlebezi etindzawo tekunatsela.
slot.act_bribe_clerk.title: Fumbatsa Umabhalane Wobufakazi
slot.act_bribe_clerk.desc: Nika umphathi wemaphoyisa lokhohlakele imali kuze akhiphe imibiko yebulletin kusuka e-N2 heist.
slot.act_bribe_clerk.clean: Umabhalane uslayida emafayela ekufanisa emabhalisthi ethebuleni lasekhantini.
slot.act_bribe_clerk.compromised: Utfola imibiko leyingxenye ngaphambi kwekutsi emaphoyisa langaphakatsi adlule.
slot.act_bribe_clerk.failure: Umabhalane utsatsa imali yakho bese ukubika ku-sergeant waMokoena.
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.title: Ngena E-ofisini yaMokoena
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.desc: Khohlisa umphathi wakho wakudala ubuso nebuso mayelana nekutsi kungani Nandi ase-BOLO list.
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.clean: Mokoena uyakukholwa futsi ukunika R3,000 njenge-retainer kuze umletsele Docket #409.
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.compromised: Mokoena ukubuka ngeliso lelibukhali ngaphesheya kwetafula lakhe. Utitfolele ema-awa langu-24.
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.failure: Mokoena uyabona kutsi uyamkhohlisa. Emasotja e-TRT akukhipha ngesibhamu.
slot.act_audit_tenders.title: Ngena E-registry Yomasipala
slot.act_audit_tenders.desc: Tente umuntfu we-compliance kuze ulandzelele ema-akhawunti e-Zululand Aqua-Logistics.
slot.act_audit_tenders.clean: Utsatsa emakhophi lasayinwe luhlelo lwe-embezzlement lwemathangi aMa-Sibi.
slot.act_audit_tenders.compromised: Emaphoyisa ekuphepha acishe akubamba e-archive, kodvwa ubaleka nemarisidi abalulekile.
slot.act_audit_tenders.failure: Alamu iyakhala esitezi sesine. Ubaleka ungenalutfo.
slot.act_masibi_deal.title: Yenta Sivumelwano ne-Chief of Staff waMa-Sibi
slot.act_masibi_deal.desc: Nikela ngekufihla lilijara ngaphambi kwekuvota kwemuhlangano wemasipala kuze utfole kuvikelwa e-City Hall.
slot.act_masibi_deal.clean: Chief of Staff waMa-Sibi ukutfumelela R5,000 wemali yekuthula futsi ukunika indlela lecondzile e-grid control room.
slot.act_masibi_deal.compromised: Chief of Staff uyavuma kusivumelwano lesingakacini, uvula indlela ye-grid yomasipala.
slot.act_masibi_deal.failure: Emaphoyisa avikela imeya akukhipha esitezi sesine bese abika e-Central Precinct.
slot.act_crack_phone.title: Hlephula Imfono Yemcwaningi
slot.act_crack_phone.desc: Dlula ku-biometric encryption kumfono wemcwaningi lofile.
slot.act_crack_phone.clean: Sparks ukhona kuhlaba encryption. Emavi lasuka e-Pier 2 ayaqala kulanda.
slot.act_crack_phone.compromised: Kuphepha kucala i-remote wipe warning, kodvwa Sparks uyayibamba i-firewall.
slot.act_crack_phone.failure: I-security ping yenta Abasanta cyber-cleaners bafike ngaphambi kwekutsi Sparks akhiphe ikhebula.
slot.act_clone_transponder.title: Kopisha Tinhlelo teSAPS Radio
slot.act_clone_transponder.desc: Yakha sikena sekungena emkhatsini kute ulandzele imiyalo ye-TRT futsi ubalekele emaphoyiseni e-SAPS.
slot.act_clone_transponder.clean: Ufake sikena se-SAPS lesikopishiwe ephaketheni—nyalo usungayiva futsi ubalekele yonkhe imigwaqo levinjelwe ngemaphoyisa ngaleso sikhatsi.
slot.act_clone_transponder.compromised: Sikena lesinomsindvo lomkhulu sisebenta kahle kute ushelele udlule emaphoyiseni.
slot.act_clone_transponder.failure: Ushise ibhodi yekushisela futsi ulahlekelwe yi-R500 etintfweni letisilekeleli.
slot.act_recon_berth14.title: Kuhlola Kwehla Kwemikhumbi e-Berth 14
slot.act_recon_berth14.desc: Tfatha titfombe temigqomo yemakhemikhali layilayisha emalolini kamasipala.
slot.act_recon_berth14.clean: Titfombe leticacile ta-Mokoena abingelela umphatsi wetitolo wa-Zuko.
slot.act_recon_berth14.compromised: Baqaphi basechwebeni babone kukhanya kwesibani sakho; ubalekela emkhatsini wetitolo.
slot.act_recon_berth14.failure: Baphenyi be-cartel bakubambe ngemuva kweloli; ubaleke ngelizinga leliphansi esangweni.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.title: [FINALE] Bhekana ne-Convoy yase-Berth 14
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.desc: Sondzela ekwehleni kweloli ebusuku kute wenze kuhlasela kwetigilanti nobe ucocisane nge-Kingpin compact e-The Glass House.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.clean: Utsatsa sikhundla ngenhla kwe-Berth 14 njengobe emaloli emanti kamasipala asondzela e-crane ya-Zuko.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.compromi: Ushelela udlula uthango ngaphansi kwemvula lenkhulu njengobe injini yeloli icala kusebenta.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.failure: Tinja tetekuphepha etitolo tikubuyisela emuva; sikhatsi sekuhambisa simphahla sesiphelile.
slot.act_handover_dockets.title: Nika Colonel van der Merwe Imibhalo
slot.act_handover_dockets.desc: Nika tikopi leticinisekisiwe te-Docket #409 kubaphenyi be-Hawks labate emacala.
slot.act_handover_dockets.clean: Van der Merwe ukhiya lifayela esefini. Ema-Hawks avula lidosi lelisemtsetfweni.
slot.act_handover_dockets.compromised: Van der Merwe ukuxwayisa kutsi Mokoena unetinhloli ngaphakathi emarekhodini ema-Hawks.
slot.act_handover_dockets.failure: Van der Merwe akekho; ushiya imibhalo kusejenti lesaba kakhulu.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.ti: [FINALE] Cala Kusakaza Kulesive kanye Nekukhipha Lofakazi
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.de: Vala iminyango yelayibrari futsi uthumele bufakazi base-Berth 14 ku-The Daily Veld kute ucale i-Act 1 Climax.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.cl: Uplink wa-Van der Merwe uxhuma ku-The Daily Veld njengobe sekungumaphakatsi ebusuku e-Berth 14.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.co: Uplink uyasebenta ngenhla kwemajama esignali e-TRT ngaphandle kwenkantolo yemajisithreti.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.fa: Umsindvo uyangenela ekusakazeni—sikhatsi semaphakatsi ebusuku e-Berth 14 sesiyasondzela.
clock.mokoena_sweep.desc: Maphoyisa e-TRT asesha i-CBD afuna Constable Nandi.
clock.nandi_condition.desc: Udinga kuhlinzwa ngokushesha ngaphambi kwekutsi sifo simhlupe.
clock.precinct_heat.desc: Tinhloli te-SAPS kanye ne-CCTV balandzela tonkhe tinyatselo takho.
clock.audit_docket_409.desc: Landzela ti-invoice temaloli emanti la-R400m kuya enkampanini yabo.
clock.crack_auditor_phone.desc: Dlula kwi-biometric encryption e-Golden Dragon Cyber-Pawn.
clock.berth_14_countdown.desc: Emalanga lasele ngaphambi kwekutsi umphahla wa-Zuko uphume e-Pier 2 (Act 1 Climax).
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.title: Tibani Letiluhlaza Emgwaqweni
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.speaker: Sergeant Dlamini
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.p1: Ticathulo letinkhulu temphi tigijima etitebhisini te-Mercury Arcade. Ngalapho emakhethini, ti-Volkswagen Golf GTI letintsatfu kanye ne-Nyala armored carrier tivala tonkhe tinhlangotsi temgwaqo.
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.p2: Siphunzi sesibhamu sishaya lisango lakho lensimbi. "Hawks Warrant Officer! Vula lisango nobe sishaye emahinji! Brigadier Mokoena ufuna lidocket lakhe!"
choice.choice_roof_escape.label: Shelela Phezu Kweluphahla lwe-Arcade
choice.choice_roof_escape.desc: Tsatsa Nandi nelidocket, khwela nge-skylight, futsi wehlele emgwaqweni wetekisi.
choice.choice_roof_escape.log: Ubalekela phezu kwensimbi legqwalile emvuleni. I-TRT ingena efulethini lelite muntfu.
choice.choice_pay_dlamini.label: Nika Sergeant Dlamini Imali (R1,200)
choice.choice_pay_dlamini.desc: Sergeant Dlamini unemacala ekugembula e-Greyville. Mkhokhele kute abike kutsi efulethini bekute muntfu.
choice.choice_pay_dlamini.log: Dlamini ulinganisa imali, ukhuluma kurediyo yakhe kutsi imininingwane beyimanga, futsi ubuyisela libutho lakhe emuva.
choice.choice_burn_decoy.label: Nikela Ngemakhasi Emanga futsi Ushaywe
choice.choice_burn_decoy.desc: Fihla emakhasi langempela ngaphansi kwemabhodi aphansi futsi wemukele kushaywa kwe-TRT.
choice.choice_burn_decoy.log: Dlamini ukushiya ulimele phansi, utsatse imibhalo yemanga uyise e-Central Precinct.
event.evt_nandi_critical.title: Septic Shock
event.evt_nandi_critical.speaker: Constable Nandi
event.evt_nandi_critical.p1: Nandi uyachakatseka kamatima ngaphansi kwengubo legcwele sitfukutsela. Inshashalata yenhlamvu etimbambeni takhe seyiphendvuke luhlaza lolumnyama lolunesihluku, kantsi uyacimata aphindze aphaphame.
event.evt_nandi_critical.p2: Uma umyisa e-Addington nobe e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Hospital, irejista yetinhlamvu itawuvisa Brigadier Mokoena kungakapheli imizuzu lemashumi lamabili.
choice.choice_emergency_maharaj.label: Khokhela Dr. Maharaj Kwekuhlinza Kwakuphutfuma (R1,500)
choice.choice_emergency_maharaj.desc: Bita udokotela losebenta ngaphandle kwemtsetfo lone-portable cauterizer kanye nema-IV antibiotics.
choice.choice_emergency_maharaj.log: Dr. Maharaj ukhipha ticucu telikhetfo lelitfusi futsi wenta Nandi atinze kungakatsi te buse.
choice.choice_hawks_extraction.label: Shayela Colonel van der Merwe Kutfola Bo-Medic be-Safe-House
choice.choice_hawks_extraction.desc: Kudzinga kwetsenjwa yi-Hawks. Nikela Nandi ethimbeni lemsebenti le-Old Archive kute atfole kwelashwa ngalokufihlekile.
choice.choice_hawks_extraction.log: Van der Merwe ushushumbisela Nandi ngeveni yekuwashela impahla amyise emtliniki lephephile yasemaphandleni.
choice.choice_public_hospital.label: Umlahle e-State Trauma Ward Bese Uyabaleka
choice.choice_public_hospital.desc: Kusindzisa imphilo yakhe mahhala, kodvwa Mokoena utawulandzela umkhondo wakho ngekushesha.
choice.choice_public_hospital.log: Bodhokotela benta Nandi atinze, kodvwa emaphoyisa ephenyo e-TRT atungeleta i-trauma ward kungakapheli li-awa.
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.title: Umkhankaso we-Operation Shanela Lockdown
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.speaker: I-Metro Police Dispatch
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.p1: Ema-siren advuma emkhatsini wetitezi letiphakeme. Ema-floodlight nemakhoni lasamvutwamvutwa avale tinhlangano temgwaco letinkhulu te-CBD njengoba i-SAPS ne-Metro Police bamise umgoqo lomatima wekuma nekusesha.
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.p2: Yonkhe i-minibus, sithuthuthu setitfunywa, kanye nalabahamba ngetinyawo bayaseshwa kutsi baphatsene netibhamu letingenamvume kanye nemadokhethi labiwe.
choice.choice_taxi_smuggle.label: Hamba Ku-VIP Kombi Convoy ya-Bra Bheki
choice.choice_taxi_smuggle.desc: Sebentisa sikhundla sakho ku-Street Syndicate kute ucebe umgoqo ngemoto yenhlangano lengatsintfwa.
choice.choice_taxi_smuggle.log: Emaphoyisa e-Metro aphekamisa tandla avumela i-Quantum ya-Bra Bheki lenengilazi lemnyama kutsi indlulisele ngaphandle kwekuhlola ema-ID.
choice.choice_spot_fine.label: Khokha Imali ye-"Cold Drink" Emgoqweni (R600)
choice.choice_spot_fine.desc: Goca emaphepha lamatsatfu e-R200 ngekhatsi kwelayisensi yakho yekushayela futsi uhlise inhloko yakho.
choice.choice_spot_fine.log: Liphoyisa lifaka emaphepha ekhukhwini, lishaye lufulelo lwemoto yakho, bese likuvumela kutsi undlule emakhonini.
choice.choice_drainage_tunnels.label: Lindzela Emiseleni Yemanzi Esitshingitshane
choice.choice_drainage_tunnels.desc: Chitsa ema-awa uhamba emantini lafika ematsendzeni ngaphansi kwe-N2 kuze kube ngulapho i-roadblock isuswa.
choice.choice_drainage_tunnels.log: Uphuma umanti te futsi ukhatsele ekuseni, kodvwa umkhondo wakho sewubandzile.
event.evt_docket_decoded.title: I-Pipeline Yematanka Emanzi
event.evt_docket_decoded.p1: Wendlala emakhasi lagcwele ingati e-Docket #409 etafuleni lakho ngaphansi kwesibani se-inverter. Ekugcineni letinombolo tiyahlangana tiyavakala.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p2: I-"Zululand Aqua-Logistics" ibilise i-City Hall R400 million kute ihambise emanzi alabikile emalokishini lasenyakatfo lomile. Kuphela nje ema-log e-GPS akhombisa kutsi lawo matanka kamasipala abazange baye emalokishini—ashayele aqonda ngco kusuka e-Pier 2 Cold Storage kuya kumagcina-mpahla etimboni ngaphandle kwelidolobha, aphelekwe ngemaveni e-TRT a-Brigadier Mokoena.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p3: Khansela Ma-Sibi akagcini nje ngekweba imali yemanzi. Ematanka akhe kamasipala atfwala tinhlobo teketshezi tekusebenta emakhemikhali e-methamphetamine kuma-super-lab a-Zuko Ndlovu.
choice.choice_unlock_leads.label: Phina i-City Hall ne-Pier 2 Ebalazweni
choice.choice_unlock_leads.desc: Ivula i-City Hall Annex (N4) kanye ne-Pier 2 Cold Storage (N6) kute uphenye ngco nobe wesabise.
choice.choice_unlock_leads.log: Impumelelo: I-City Hall Annex kanye ne-Pier 2 Cold Storage nyalo tiyavuleka ebalazweni lesigodzi sakho.
event.evt_phone_decrypted.title: I-Voice Note Lesuka e-Berth 14
event.evt_phone_decrypted.speaker: Sparks
event.evt_phone_decrypted.p1: Sparks ukhipha lifu lentfutfu ye-vape ngesikhatsi licingo lalomcwaningi-mabhuku lofile ligcina lidlule i-biometric lock yalo. Ngephakathi kwefolda lefihliwe kuhlala kurekhodwa kwemsindvo lokuvikelekile kanye ne-shipping manifest yalamuhla ebusuku.
event.evt_phone_decrypted.p2: Ekurekhodweni, livi lelirhabulako la-Brigadier Mokoena aliphambaniseki: "Cisani i-weighbridge ye-N2 phakathi kwamabili. I-container ya-Zuko yehla e-Berth 14, kantsi nanobe ngubani we-Hawks lonukisa lapha utawugqitjwa emgodzini wetimayini."
choice.choice_take_manifest.label: Dawuniloda i-Manifest ye-Berth 14 kanye ne-Hawks Contact
choice.choice_take_manifest.desc: Ivula i-The Old Archive Basement (N7) futsi ikunika emandla ekubamba Mokoena na-Zuko ngemitsiko.
choice.choice_take_manifest.log: Ufaka i-cloned drive ekhukhwini. Indzawo yasegumbini leliphansi la-Colonel van der Merwe nyalo seyitfolakala.
event.evt_climax_berth14.title: Phakathi Kwamabili e-Berth 14: Umdlalo Wekugcina
event.evt_climax_berth14.speaker: I-Port Control & Tactical Dispatch
event.evt_climax_berth14.p1: Imvula itsatsa eceleni ku-Natal Port Channel ngesikhatsi ema-gantry crane lamakhulu e-Pier 2 aphuma enkungwini. Ngaphansi kwe-Berth 14, ematanka lamanzi kamasipala lamatsatfu amile eceleni kwema-container lasafrishiwe a-Zuko Ndlovu, azungezwe ngema-Nyala e-TRT la-Brigadier Mokoena lanemalambu laluhlaza sasibhakabhaka.
event.evt_climax_berth14.p2: Sikhatsi sakho sesiphelile. Nobe ufike lapha uphete emabhuku e-treasury ladidiyelwe, ema-voice note lavikelekile emcwaningi-mabhuku, nobe ngemandla emgwaco kuphela, unelithuba linye lekudlala likhadi lakho ngaphambi kokuba lolu luhla lwetimoto luphumele ku-N2 highway.
choice.climax_choice_vigilante.label: [INDLELA YE-VIGILANTE] Shaya Lizwi Ku-Izinkabi Ta-Bra Bheki Bese Ushisa Lolu Luhla Lwetimoto
choice.climax_choice_vigilante.desc: Vusa imphi lenkhulu emachwebeni emkhatsini we-Queen Street Syndicate kanye nemabutfo e-TRT ka-Mokoena, shisa emaloli emakhemikhali, futsi webe imali le-R450,000 le-cartel.
choice.climax_choice_vigilante.log: Tinhlamvu letikhanyako tishisa emagubu e-Pier 2 njengobe wephula imoto yemiyalo futsi unyamalala ebumnyameni nemali le-cartel.
choice.climax_choice_whistleblower.label: [INDLELA YEMHLOLI] Sakata i-Dossier ku-The Daily Veld & Hawks
choice.climax_choice_whistleblower.desc: Sakaza irekhodi le-water-tanker lelihloliwe kanye nokuphawula kwelivi la-Mokoena kulo lonke lelive ngenkathi Colonel van der Merwe akhipha Constable Nandi amfaka ekuvikelweni kofakazi.
choice.climax_choice_whistleblower.log: Nge-06:00 ekuseni, livi la-Brigadier Mokoena liyadlala kuso sonkhe siteshi semisakato eNingizimu Afrika kantsi i-Treasury ivimba i-tender ya-Ma-Sibi le-R400m.
choice.climax_choice_kingpin.label: [INDLELA YENKHOSI] Nyukela e-The Glass House & Funa i-20% ye-Pipeline
choice.climax_choice_kingpin.desc: Hlangana na-Zuko Ndlovu, i-Chief of Staff ya-Ma-Sibi, kanye na-Brigadier Mokoena etulu kwetilokwe teluswayo. Shisa i-Docket #409 wena uqobo ukuze ubuyiselwe emsebentini futsi ube ngumlingani we-syndicate.
choice.climax_choice_kingpin.log: Uphonsa i-Docket #409 emlilweni etulu e-The Glass House. Kumiswa kwakho kususwa, futsi imali yakho yekucala le-R80,000 yeloli ingena ngaphambi kwekusa.
choice.climax_choice_captured.label: [AKUKHO KUSEKELWA] Ubanjiwe ku-Pier 2 Perimeter Dragnet
choice.climax_choice_captured.desc: Ngaphandle kwerekhodi lelihloliwe nobe imininingwane ye-Berth 14, bahloli be-TRT ba-Mokoena bakuvimba ngaphambi kwekutsi ufike echwebeni.
choice.climax_choice_captured.log: Tine ti-Golf GTI te-TRT letinganambitheki tiyavimba kubaleka kwakho emvuleni. I-Docket #409 iyabanjwa ngaphambi kwekusa.
event.evt_composure_breakdown.title: Kwesaba Kwebumnyama: Kuhluleka Kwemiva
event.evt_composure_breakdown.speaker: Kucabanga Kwangaphakathi
event.evt_composure_breakdown.p1: Tandla takho atiyeki kudzangazela. Emkhatsini wemusi we-diesel, kukhala kwema-siren e-Queen Street, kanye netinyanga letisitfupha ubuka emuva kwakho, umbono wakho uba mnyama.
event.evt_composure_breakdown.p2: Uwa ngemhlane etitebhisini letimanzi tase-Mercury Arcade, ulwisana nekuphefumula. Nangabe ungatibambi tinzwa takho manje, utawenta liphutsa lelibulalako.
choice.choice_breakdown_stimulants.label: Tsenga imitsi le-black-market e-Arcade Kiosk (R500)
choice.choice_breakdown_stimulants.desc: Kukubuyisela ekugxileni ngokushesha (+45% Composure), noko umtsengisi uyakhuluma (+1 Precinct Heat).
choice.choice_breakdown_stimulants.log: Tiphilisi letibabako tishukumisa tinzwa takho kutsi tibuyele ekugxileni (+45% Composure, +1 Precinct Heat).
choice.choice_breakdown_hawks_medic.labe: Bita i-medic ya-Colonel van der Merwe (Hawks Rep >= 1)
choice.choice_breakdown_hawks_medic.desc: Sebentisa kwetsemba kwakho kwema-Hawks kute utfole umjovo we-adrenaline kanye nekuvikelwa (+50% Composure).
choice.choice_breakdown_hawks_medic.log: I-paramedic lehlalile phansi ikulungisa ngemuva kwemoto le-unmarked (+50% Composure, -1 Sweep).
choice.choice_breakdown_passout.label: Lala phansi e-Safehouse kuze kudzangazela kume
choice.choice_breakdown_passout.desc: Kutfola +35% Composure mahhala, kodvwa ulahlekelwa ngema-awa laligugu ngenkathi inethi ya-Mokoena icina (+1 Sweep, +1 Nandi’s Wound).
choice.choice_breakdown_passout.log: Uvuka ngemuva kwema-awa lamanyenti phansi e-linoleum (+35% Composure, kodvwa Threat Clocks ayachubeka).
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.title: Encrypted Wire: I-4th-Floor Olive Branch
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.speaker: Councillor Ma-Sibi's Chief of Staff
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.p1: Njengobe ematekisi ekuseni acala kukhala e-Queen Street, ifoni yakho le-burner iyadlidliza ngemlayeto we-Signal longakafakwa kuhlu kusuka e-City Hall 4th Floor.
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.p2: "Warrant Officer. Siyati kutsi Constable Nandi ukulethele emaphepha a-Mandla Sithole. Kute e-City Hall lofuna lomunye umngcwabo. Yehlisa umfutfo wakho we-audit lamuhla, futsi i-R800 municipal consulting retainer itawufakwa ebhokisini lakho leposi kungakapheli li-awa."
choice.choice_masibi_accept_retainer.des: Faka i-R800 ephaketheni futsi utfole +1 City Hall Rep, kodvwa kucitsa -10% Composure njengobe ubeketelela inkohlakalo.
choice.choice_masibi_accept_retainer.log: Umthumeli uwehlisela imvilophu le-brown le-municipal lenemali le-R800 ebhokisini lakho le-arcade (+R800, +1 City Hall Rep).
choice.choice_masibi_trace_packet.label: Back-Trace i-Burner Message Header (WIRE >= 1)
choice.choice_masibi_trace_packet.desc: Sebentisa likhono lakho le-signals kute ukhiphe i-metadata emlayetweni we-Chief of Staff (+1 Crack Auditor’s Handset).
choice.choice_masibi_trace_packet.log: Utsumba i-municipal server certificate kusuka ku-message header (+1 Crack Auditor’s Handset).
choice.choice_masibi_burn_sim.label: Phula i-Burner SIM kabili & Chubeka Ufuna
choice.choice_masibi_burn_sim.desc: Ala kutsi utengwe (+10% Composure, +1 Hawks Rep, -1 City Hall Rep).
choice.choice_masibi_burn_sim.log: Uphula i-SIM card kabili futsi uyiphonsa emgwaqweni wemvula (+10% Composure, +1 Hawks Rep).
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.title: Morning Dispatch: Umgeni Feeder Cable Stripped
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.location: West Street & Umgeni Corridor • Cycle 3 Dawn
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.speaker: Bra Bheki Sithole
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.p1: Intfutfu lenkhulu lemnyama iyenyuka kusuka e-Umgeni substation ekuseni. I-syndicate lebeyeba ticu tethusi ikhiphe ticu letintsatfu letinamandla lamakhulu ebusuku, yenta emalambu emgwaqweni e-CBD adideka.
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.p2: Emaphoyisa emgwaqo a-Bra Bheki atsatse emaphambanweni ngemashitolo kanye netinduku, kantsi emaloli e-SAPS abambeke emgwaqweni emabhuloki lamabili kuleyo ndzawo.
choice.choice_cable_help_bheki.label: Sita emaphoyisa a-Bra Bheki kutsi alungise umgwaqo ekuseni
choice.choice_cable_help_bheki.desc: Utfola i-R500 kusuka emaphoyiseni emgwaqo kanye ne-+1 Street Syndicate standing.
choice.choice_cable_help_bheki.log: Ukhulula umgwaqo we-delivery wema-Quantum a-Bra Bheki futsi ufaka i-R500 ephaketheni (+R500, +1 Street Syndicate Rep).
choice.choice_cable_scrub_cctv.label: Sebentisa kucima kwemagetsi kute usule tikhamera te-ANPR tase-Precinct
choice.choice_cable_scrub_cctv.desc: Sebentisa kwehla kwemagetsi esiteshini kute usule imininingwane yemalayisensi (-2 Precinct Heat).
choice.choice_cable_scrub_cctv.log: Kwehla kwemagetsi esiteshini konakalise imininingwane yekhamera yemigwaco yase-Central Precinct yemahora langu-24 langaphambilini (-2 Precinct Heat).
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.title: Umyalezo Waphuthumako: MV Southern Cross Ise-Berth 14
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.speaker: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p1: Liphondo liyakhala emkhunjini njengobe umkhumbi i-MV Southern Cross ungena ethekwini. Umsakato wakho lo-encrypted uyaqala kukhala ngelivi la-Colonel van der Merwe.
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p2: "Lalelisisa. Emadrumu emakhemikhali a-Zuko Ndlovu ayekhishwa e-Berth 14 ebusuku, futsi emaveni e-TRT a-Mokoena asevele alindile e-weighbridge. Qinisekisa kutsi uba ne-Decoded Tanker Ledger nobe i-Berth 14 Manifest ngaphambi kwekutsi libhodi lishaye phakatsi ebusuku."
choice.choice_port_lock_and_load.label: Hlola I-Evidence Dossier Yakho & Tilungiselele Busuku
choice.choice_port_lock_and_load.desc: Ticinise emandla kute ulungele sigaba sekugcina (+15% Composure).
choice.choice_port_lock_and_load.log: I-MV Southern Cross isethekwini. Busuku ngibo lobu bekugcina be-Berth 14 (+15% Composure).
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.title: Kudubulana e-M4 Flyover
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.location: Umhlanga M4 Highway Overpass • Phakatsi Ebusuku
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.speaker: Izinkabi Letivela Ngaphandle
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.p1: Emabakkie lamabili lamhlophe langabhalisiwe akuvimbele emgwaqweni ngase-M4 coastal flyover. Kukhanya kwemabhulashi emibhamu kukhanyisa imvula njengobe tinhlamvu tiyaqala kushaya esibukweni semoto yakho.
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.p2: Zuko na-Brigadier Mokoena bafake emalunga abo ekubulala lavela ngaphandle kute baqinisekise kutsi awufiki enkantolo yase-High Court njengofakazi.
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ram.label: Shaya i-Bakkie Lebhangele & Ubuyisele Emuva (STREET >= 2)
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ram.desc: Dabula kulokuvimbelwa ngemasu latfolakele (-2 Hit Squad, -10% Composure).
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ram.log: Ushaye i-bakkie lephambili wayiphusha emaceleni wabe sewunyamalala emigwaqweni yelokishi (Hit Squad clock reset).
choice.choice_act2_ambush_payoff.label: Tfumela R900 nge-Bra Bheki’s Rank Marshals kute ukhanselise lesivumelwano
choice.choice_act2_ambush_payoff.desc: Sebentisa imigudu yebugebengu kanye ne-R900 kute ukhokhele lababulali.
choice.choice_act2_ambush_payoff.log: Lucingo lunye lolusuka e-Queen Street lukhanselise lababulali (-R900, Hit Squad clock reset).
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ditch.label: Eqa Uye Emgodini Wemvula
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ditch.desc: Uyasinda kodvwa ulimale kakhulu (-30% Composure, +1 Contempt Warrant), kodvwa uyabaleka endzaweni yekubulala.
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ditch.log: Imoto yakho igcwele tinhlamvu njengobe ugingqika uya emgodini logcwele emanti (-30% Composure, Hit Squad reset).
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.title: State Security Contempt Warrant
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.speaker: Advocate Vermeulen
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.p1: Emaphoyisa kanye netikhulu te-State Security bakuvimbele etitepisini tase-High Court, baphetse incwadzi yekuboshwa lesayinwe ngaphansi kwe-Protection of State Information Act.
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.p2: "Uyalwa kutsi uboshwe ngaphansi kwemthetho wekuvikela imininingwane yemasipala lengavumelekile."
choice.choice_act2_contempt_quash.label: Sebentisa Section 205 Whistleblower Immunity (DOCKETS >= 2)
choice.choice_act2_contempt_quash.desc: Citsa le-warrant enkantolo (+1 Hawks Rep, resets Contempt Warrant).
choice.choice_act2_contempt_quash.log: Jaji Khumalo ukhanselile le-warrant enkantolo njengobe emakhamera ethelevishini abukele (Contempt Warrant reset).
choice.choice_act2_contempt_bail.label: Khokha R800 Emergency Senior Counsel Bail
choice.choice_act2_contempt_bail.desc: Khokha R800 kute uhlale ungaphandle kwesitokisi.
choice.choice_act2_contempt_bail.log: Lommeli wakho uphumelele kutfola imvume yekutsi uhlale ungaphandle (-R800, Contempt Warrant reset).
choice.choice_act2_contempt_flee.label: Baleka nge-Magistrates’ Basement Tunnel
choice.choice_act2_contempt_flee.desc: Ubalekela kuboshwa kodvwa ulahlekelwa -25% Composure kanye +1 Hit Squad heat.
choice.choice_act2_contempt_flee.log: Ubalekele ngemhubhe wangaphansi kwemhlaba ngaphambi kwekutsi emaketane akubambe (-25% Composure, +1 Hit Squad).
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.title: Kutfola Lokutsite: Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.location: High Court Evidence Vault • Encrypted Uplink
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.speaker: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.p1: I-printer esehhovisi la-Colonel van der Merwe iyaqala kusebenta, ikhipha imininingwane ye-DIFC Dubai beneficial-ownership register ye-Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.p2: Naku lokumnyama nekumhlophe: Zuko Ndlovu (45%), Councillor Ma-Sibi (30%), kanye na-Brigadier Titus Mokoena (25%)—kanye ne-charter escrow ye-Gulfstream G550 (Flight ZS-900) lelindile e-King Shaka Hangar 7 kanye nemaphepha emhlaba we-Lot 44 e-Midlands.
choice.choice_act2_claim_trust_deed.labe: Qinisekisa i-Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed & Vula Imikhondo Yasemkhatsini
choice.choice_act2_claim_trust_deed.desc: Yengeza i-Sovereign Pearl Offshore Trust Deed kule-inventory yakho futsi ivula i-Hydroponic Citrus Estate (N11) & King Shaka Cargo Apron (N12).
choice.choice_act2_claim_trust_deed.log: Uthole i-Sovereign Pearl Offshore Trust Deed! Uvule i-Midlands Citrus Estate (N11) kanye ne-King Shaka Cargo Apron (N12).
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.title: Impumelelo: I-Telemetry yase-Midlands Packhouse
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.speaker: Bra Bheki Sithole
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.p1: I-GPS plot ebetshintshelwe ngu-Sparks ihambisana kahle nemephu yezolimo yesifundazwe. Wonke amaloli amanzi kamasipala abhalelwe emalokishini omile asenyakatho empeleni ayedluliselwa emgwaqweni u-N3 kuya e-Lot 44: i-Hydroponic Citrus Estate.
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.p2: Okungcono kakhulu, imininingwane yempahla ikhombisa amathani angu-1.8 omkhiqizo oqediwe we-crystal otholwe emaphalethini ewolintshi athunyelwa e-Hangar 7 esikhumulweni sezindiza i-King Shaka International ebusuku.
choice.choice_act2_claim_telemetry.label: Bhalisa i-Midlands Batch Telemetry futhi uvule izindawo zangaphakathi
choice.choice_act2_claim_telemetry.desc: Yengeza i-Midlands Super-Lab Batch Telemetry ohlwini lwakho futhi uvule i-Hydroponic Citrus Estate (N11) kanye ne-King Shaka Cargo Apron (N12).
choice.choice_act2_claim_telemetry.log: Uthole i-Midlands Super-Lab Batch Telemetry! Uvule i-Midlands Citrus Estate (N11) kanye ne-King Shaka Cargo Apron (N12).
event.evt_act2_morning_commission_leak.p: Amaphephandaba ase-KwaZulu-Natal aphethe izihloko ezinkulu ezivela kwiKhomishini Yophenyo. E-Umhlanga Ridge, imishini yokusika amaphepha isebenza ngokweqile njengoba abaqondisi bezinkampani zephepha bephuthuma ukubhukha izindiza eziphuma e-King Shaka.
choice.choice_act2_morning_press_pack.la: Nikeza imininingwane kwi-Court Press Gallery (+1 Trace Trust, +1 Contempt)
choice.choice_act2_morning_press_pack.de: Gcina ukunaka komphakathi kugxile ku-Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
choice.choice_act2_morning_press_pack.lo: Iphakethe lakho lezindaba elingaziwa liphoqa abaqondisi bebhange ukuba bazivikele (+1 Trace Trust).
choice.choice_act2_morning_lay_low.label: Shintsha izimoto zokuphepha futhi ugcine u-Nandi efihliwe
choice.choice_act2_morning_lay_low.desc: Dukisa ababheki baka-Zuko (-1 Hit Squad, +10% Composure).
choice.choice_act2_morning_lay_low.log: Ushintsha amapuleti egalaji elingaphansi, ushiya iqembu elibulalayo lizungeza ihhotela elingenamuntu (-1 Hit Squad, +10% Composure).
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.title: Ukundiza e-Hangar 7: Isiphetho Sokugcina
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.speaker: Zuko Ndlovu, Cllr. Ma-Sibi & Brig. Mokoena
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p1: Imvula efudumele yasogwini ishaya ukhonkolo okhanyiswe ngamalambu e-Hangar 7. Ama-turbine amabili e-Rolls-Royce e-Gulfstream ZS-900 akhala kakhulu njengoba amaqembu ama-forklift elayisha amaphalethi okugcina amabhondi nezikhwama zediplomacy.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p2: Ezansi nezitebhisi zendiza kumi abakhi abathathu bokubanjwa kwe-eThekwini-Gold: u-Zuko Ndlovu egqoke ijazi lakhe elingenabala, u-Councillor Ma-Sibi ephethe ipasipoti yakhe yediplomacy, kanye no-Brigadier Mokoena nesibhamu sakhe esikhombe kuthala emanzi.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p3: "Imizuzu emihlanu ngaphambi kokundiza, Warrant Officer," kusho u-Zuko ngaphezu komsindo wendiza. "Nquma ukuthi hlobo luni lwezwe oluvukayo kulo kusasa."
choice.choice_act2_ending_reckoning.labe: [CONSTITUTIONAL RECKONING] Khipha imvume yokuboshwa ye-High Court futhi umise i-ZS-900
choice.choice_act2_ending_reckoning.desc: Kudinga i-Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed noma i-Super-Lab Telemetry. Hola iyunithi yama-Hawks ka-Col. van der Merwe uye kuthala ubophe bobathathu phambi kwesizwe.
choice.choice_act2_ending_reckoning.log: Izimoto ezihlomile zama-Hawks zivala umzila njengoba wethula icala le-High Court ngesibhamu.
choice.choice_act2_ending_revolution.lab: [DRY-TAP UPRISING] Thatha amaloli amanzi futhi unikeze izigidi zase-Midlands emalokishini
choice.choice_act2_ending_revolution.des: Kudinga i-Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed noma i-Super-Lab Telemetry. Vumela amaphoyisa esiteleka ka-Bra Bheki ahlasele i-Hangar 7, athathe imali ye-syndicate engu-R400m, futhi avule amanzi.
choice.choice_act2_ending_revolution.log: Amakhulu amatekisi namaloli kamasipala aphula uthango, ethatha ingcebo ye-cartel eyela emalokishini omile.
choice.choice_act2_ending_syndicate_stat: [THE GHOST SOVEREIGN] Vumela indiza i-ZS-900 ihambe ngokushintshana ngokhiye be-Master Trust
Kudinga i-Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed noma i-Super-Lab Telemetry. Vumela osopolitiki babaleke baye e-Dubai ngenkathi uthatha umyalo ophelele wemboni yezokuthutha yesithunzi yesifundazwe.
U-Zuko ukuphonsela ukhiye we-cryptographic kusuka ezitebhisini njengoba i-ZS-900 igijima emzileni iqonde esivunguvungwini.
choice.choice_act2_ending_vanished.label: [UNARMED ON THE APRON] Bhekana ne-Triumvirate ngaphandle kobufakazi obuqinisekisiwe
choice.choice_act2_ending_vanished.desc: Uma ufike e-Hangar 7 ngaphandle kwe-Trust Deed noma i-Super-Lab Telemetry, abaqaphi baka-Mokoena bavalela iminyango ye-hangar ngemuva kwakho.
choice.choice_act2_ending_vanished.log: Ngaphandle kobufakazi be-High Court, amalambu e-hangar ayacima kanti umsindo wendiza umisa ukudubula kwakho kokugcina.
ending.ending_vigilante.title: Umlilo Wasechwebeni
ending.ending_vigilante.subtitle: Pier 2 Container Terminal • 01:40 AM (Stage 6 Blackout)
ending.ending_vigilante.quote: "Lapho umthetho uthengiwe kanti izwe lithunjiwe, ubulungiswa obusele kuphela umdlalo owushayayo ebumnyameni."
ending.ending_vigilante.hook: ACT 2 PREVIEW: Njengoba impi yezindawo isabalala emalokishini asenyakatho, ikhomishini yophenyo kazwelonke ifika ivela e-Pretoria—futhi bobabili u-Zuko no-Mokoena bafuna uthuliswe ngaphambi kokuba ufakaze.
ending.ending_whistleblower.title: Ikhasi Lokuqala le-The Daily Veld
ending.ending_whistleblower.subtitle: Old Archive Sub-Basement & National Broadcast • 06:00 AM
ending.ending_whistleblower.quote: "Bangashisa idokodo lephepha bathenge nomantshi, kodwa abakwazi ukubuyisela amakhulu amane ezigidi zamaRandi ebumnyameni uma lonke izwe selizwile irekhodi."
ending.ending_whistleblower.hook: ACT 2 PREVIEW: Njengoba u-Mokoena ebalekile njengomholi wempi oyingozi kanti u-Nandi elungiselela ukufakaza e-High Court, kufanele ugcine ufakazi wakho omkhulu ephila amahora angu-72.

ending.ending_kingpin.subtitle: Penthouse Atop the Harbour Grain Silos • Midnight
ending.ending_kingpin.quote: "E-eThekwini-Gold, kute lokwenta lokungahlula umshini. Utawucindzetelwa ngaphansi kwemathanki, nobe utitselele sikhundla kule-valve."
ending.ending_kingpin.hook: KUBUKA KUSASEPHBILI KWESIGABA 2: Liphoyisa Nandi liyala imali yakho yegazi bese linyamalala etilokishini liphetse likhophi le-docket—lokukucindzetela kutsi ulandzele lophayini wakho wakadzeni.
ending.ending_captured.title: Ungcwatshwe e-Shaft 9
ending.ending_captured.subtitle: Tindzawo Letishiyiwe Te-Gold ne-Coal Ngaphandle Kwelidolobha • Ngaphambi Kwekusa
ending.ending_captured.quote: "Lidolobha alidzingi licala nakukhona kucishwa kwemagesi kwesigaba 6 kanye ne-bakkie lengenamaki lokwenta umsebenti ngaphambi kwekusa."
ending.ending_captured.hook: ZAMA LUNYE UCHUNGECHUNGE: Lawula kuthula kwakho, usebentise inethiwekhi yetekisi yase-Queen Street kute wehlise i-clock ya-Mokoena, uvule i-Pier 2 ngaphambi kwekutsi umgibe uvaleke.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.title: Ku-TV Yavelonkhe
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.subtitle: King Shaka Hangar 7 & Titepisi TeNkantolo Lephakeme • Kusa
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.quote: "Kwekucala eminyakeni lelishumi nakubili, emalambu eliphoyisa abengasusi imigwaqo yetikhulu—abebabopha ngetinsimbi."
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.hook: UMKHANKHASO UPHEDZILE (SIGABA 1 + SIGABA 2): Usindzile ekucisheni kwemagesi, wembula lisu le-Sovereign Pearl, futsi waletsa labangathintwa base-eThekwini-Gold enkantolo.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.title: Umkhankhaso Webantfu
ending.ending_act2_revolution.subtitle: Northern Township Reservoir & Hangar 7 • Kusa
ending.ending_act2_revolution.quote: "Bebeba emanti futsi basitsengisela lomile. Ngalobubusuku sititsatsele emaloli, ematepu, kanye ne-akhawunti yasebhange."
ending.ending_act2_revolution.hook: UMKHANKHASO UPHEDZILE (SIGABA 1 + SIGABA 2): Uphule lisu le-state-capture kusukela phansi waphindze wabuyisela kuphila kwase-eThekwini-Gold kubantfu bayo.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.title: Sihlalo Webhodi
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.quote: "Imibuso ayiwi ngenkathi inkhosi igibela indiza. Basuke bashintja nje emasayinitho kule-trust deed."
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.hook: UMKHANKHASO UPHEDZILE (SIGABA 1 + SIGABA 2): Udlule wonkhe umuntfu e-eThekwini-Gold futsi watitsatela sikhundla sembuso wemthunzi.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.title: Kuvalwe Iminyaka Lengamashumi Lasihlanu
ending.ending_act2_vanished.subtitle: King Shaka Cargo Apron • 01:15 AM
ending.ending_act2_vanished.quote: "Nge-oda laSihlalo, Exhibit 409-B iyahlukaniswa ngaphansi kwemitsetfo ye-National Key Points."
ending.ending_act2_vanished.hook: ZAMA SIGABA 2 FUTSI: Cedza i-clock letsi "Trace Sovereign Pearl Trust" (e-Ridge nobe eNkantolo Lephakeme) nobe i-clock letsi "Synthesize Super-Lab Telemetry" (e-Northern Township Depot) ngaphambi kwekutsi ubambe indiza ZS-900!
bg.forensic_hawk.title: Umcwaningi Wetitifiketi Temali
bg.forensic_hawk.tagline: Ulandzela emaRandi etinkampanini temanga nakumathenda kamasipala.
bg.forensic_hawk.desc: UBrigadier Mokoena wakubeka licala ngemanga ngesikhatsi kuhlola kwakho emathangi emanti kamasipala kusondzela eHholweni Ledolobha. Angeke ulwe nelicembu lebabulali buso nebubuso, kodvwa nangabe unikwe libhuku letimali namabhalane wenkantolo, ungawisa umbuso wonkhe.
bg.trt_breacher.title: Umphoqeleli Loshile
bg.trt_breacher.tagline: Uyati kutsi emabutfo ekubulala aMokoena asebenta kanjani ngobe wawuhola linye lawo.
bg.trt_breacher.desc: Wadzilita iminyango kusukela KwaMashu kuya ePoint wate wala umyalo wekuhlela kudubulana ePier 2. Bonkhe baphatsi bamatekisi nebaphatsi betiteshi bayasati sibuko sakho—futhi bayasihlonipha kukhanyisa kwesibhamu sakho.
bg.crime_intel.title: Umhloli Wetintsambo Wesipoko
bg.crime_intel.tagline: Kuhlolwa kwemibhoshongo yebucingo, ema-transponder mbumbulu, nekusabisa lokungekho emtfonjeni.
bg.crime_intel.desc: Wawuhlala ngemuva kweveni lengenamphawulo ulalela tinhloko tetigebengu tihleba emakhanseleni edolobha. Ngesikhatsi lomunye acisha iseva lenkhulu wasola wena, wagcina emadrayivu ekuvikela afihliwe kuyo yonkhe i-CBD.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p1: Nge-timbili ekuseni, lugesi lwemaspala lufa ngemsindvo losindzako kusuka esiteshini sase-Queen Street. Ifeni yeluphahla iyama. Ngaphandle kwemafasitela akho, imvula yase-coast ishaya luphahla lwe-zinc lwase-Mercury Arcade, lokukhanyiswe kuphela ngembala wemlilo we-generator yase-spaza shop ngaphesheya kwemgwaqo.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p2: Etafuleni lakho kukhona libhodlela le-cane spirits lelingaphelele kanye nencwadzi yekumiswa lokusayine Brigadier Titus Mokoena tinyanga letisitfupha letendlulile.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p3: Bese kufika umsindvo—hhayi kwi-buzzer yaphansi, kodvwa kukhahlela lokusheshako lokumanzi etinsimbini takho te-Trellidor etulu kwesitepisi semlilo. Ngaphambi kwekutsi ufikelele ku-9mm Parabellum ngaphansi kwemathilasi akho, khumbula kutsi ubungubani ngaphambi kwekutsi Mokoena angcwabe umsebenti wakho:
popt.pick_forensic.label: Khetsa Sisekelo: Umhloli Wetincwadzi (+2 Dockets, +1 Influence)
popt.pick_breacher.label: Khetsa Sisekelo: Liphoyisa Lelishisiwe (+2 Street, +1 Dockets)
popt.pick_intel.label: Khetsa Sisekelo: Umhloli Wetingcingo (+2 Wire, +1 Influence)
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p1: Ulungisa i-Z88 yakho bese uya eceleni kwemnyango. Ngembobo, libhalu le-emergency liyacwayiza phezu kwe-windbreaker lemanzi ye-SAPS.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p2: Liphoyisa Nandi—lokuphela kwemuntfu lomusha esiteshini lowala kusayina i-affidavit yemanga ya-Mokoena ngawe. Ubambe tinhlangotsi takhe tase-khatsi, ingati lemnyama iphuma emkhatsini weminwe yakhe, anedocket lenkhulu lensundu kanye ne-smartphone lephukile ngaphansi kwengalo yakhe.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p3: "Warrant..." uyaphefumula, emehlo akhe abuka emthunzini wesitepisi. "Vula lisango. Ngiyacela. Emaloli a-Mokoena a-TRT asandza kudlula etekisini. Nangabe i-transponder yami isasebenta, base emabhulokini lamabili ngemuva kwami."
popt.opt_wire_kill_radio.label: [WIRE] Susa ibhetri kanye ne-GPS module kwi-handset yakhe ye-SAPS kucala
popt.opt_street_clear_alley.label: [STREET] Hlola umgwaqo, umfake ngaphakathi, bese uvalela lisango
popt.opt_standard_pull_in.label: Vula i-Trellidor umfake phansi ekhishini
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p1: Ucindzetela lithawula lelihlantekile etinhlangotsini takhe. Inhlamvu ye-9mm imlimaze kancane—ijule kwenele kutsi iphume ingati, futsi iyingoti kakhulu kutsi ungayithunga esibhedlela se-state lapho emabhalane emaphoyisa abhalisa wonkhe umuntfu lodutshuliwe.
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p2: Nandi ufaka i-Docket #409 kanye ne-smartphone lenegazi ezandleni takho. "Siphendvule ekubanjweni kwemali ku-N2 south ramp phakatsi ebusuku. Iloli le-G4S lishaywe nge-C4, Warrant. Kodvwa bekute emakhasethi emali ngaphakathi."
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p3: Uginya mate, atfutfumela. "Bekunemhloli wemasipala lofile aboshwe ngetinsimbi phansi, kanye nalerejista. Emarandi lamakhulu lamane etithenda temaloli emanti aphuthumako adluliswe ngehhovisi lelikhansela Ma-Sibi kuya etindlini tekugcina tase-port ta-Zuko Ndlovu. Ngesikhatsi lophayini wami alama kutsi akubhale, Brigadier Mokoena ufike nge-bakkie le-TRT lengenamaki... wamdubula esifubeni."
popt.opt_dockets_inspect.label: [DOCKETS] Vula i-Docket #409 ubuke emastampu emvume yebhange
popt.opt_influence_calm_nandi.label: [INFLUENCE] "Phefumula, Nandi. Mokoena akati kukhona leli-flat. Usaphila."
popt.opt_ask_phone.label: "Ngubani lolu cingo? Futhi ngubani omunye okubonile ubaleka ku-N2?"
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p1: Nandi uquleka kusofa wakho njengoba ukusa okumpunga kwase-coast kungena ngama-blinds. Ngaphandle, amatekisi aqala ukukhala izimpondo ku-Queen Street.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p2: Unezinkinga ezimbili ezikukhathazayo: Isilonda sika-Nandi sokudutshulwa sizobola zingakapheli izinsuku ezine ngaphandle kokuthi ukhokhele udokotela ongabhalisiwe (R1,500), futhi amabutho e-TRT ka-Brigadier Mokoena asesha isifunda ngendlu ngendlu.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p3: Ezandleni zakho kukhona ubufakazi obuxhumanisa i-City Hall, i-SAPS Organized Crime, kanye ne-Abasanta Cartel. Amadayisi akho ansuku zonke alungele etafuleni.
popt.opt_start_game.label: Nyathela ebalazweni lesifunda (Qala umjikelezo 1)
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.title: Ngena kwi-Fiduciary Escrow Server
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.desc: Ngena kwi-server yangasese yokuphatha ingcebo esitezi sama-28 ukuze ulandelele i-Sovereign Pearl offshore shell trust.
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.clean: Ukungena okuhlanzekile. Ukhopisha izitifiketi ze-DIFC Dubai ngaphambi kokuthi i-firewall yezokuphepha yangasese isabele.
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.compromise: Uthola uhhafu wama-registry, kodwa i-alamu ethule ikhomba i-MAC address yakho eqenjini lezomthetho (+1 Contempt Warrant).
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.failure: Izivalo ze-biometric ziyavaleka. Ubaleka kancane ngezitebhisi zabasebenzi njengoba onogada abahlomile besesha indawo.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.title: Cindezela u-Tender Consultant e-Sky-Bar
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.desc: Valela ummeli wentela wangaphandle ka-Councillor Ma-Sibi phezu kwe-scotch bese ufuna imali yokuthula.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.clean: Utshelela i-casino chip ye-platinum kanye ne-R1,100 cash phezu kwetafula, ethembisa ukubambezela i-contempt warrant.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.compromis: Ukhokha u-R650 ephaketheni lakhe ukuze agcine igama lakhe lingekho ohlwini, nakuba unogada wakhe ethatha izithombe zamapuleti emoto yakho.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.failure: Uyakuhleka ebusweni bese eshayela ikhishi lezokuphepha le-Commission ukubika ukwesatshiswa kofakazi.
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.title: Khipha i-Black-Box GPS kwi-Tanker #114
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.desc: Vula i-dashboard telemetry unit yethangi likamasipala eliboshiwe ukuze ulandelele izindawo ezimile kulo ebusuku e-Midlands.
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.clean: Njengoba onogada baka-Bra Bheki bebhekile, ukhipha izixhumanisi zomgwaqo wase-Howick (+2 Lab Telemetry).
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.compromised: Ukhumula i-GPS module, kodwa umhloli we-cartel osemgwaqeni ubona isithunzi sakho (+1 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.failure: Izintambo zokuthungela ezibekwe izingibe ziyavutha ezandleni zakho, zikhanga onogada abahlomile.
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.title: Xhumana ne-Strike Committee (R400)
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.desc: Xhasa onogada bamanzi base-township ukuze babeke imigoqo yomphakathi ehamba kancane ama-hit squads e-cartel.
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.clean: Amathayi avuthayo nemigoqo yamatekisi ivala imigwaqo esenyakatho—izibhamu zika-Zuko ziphoqeleka ukuhlehla (-2 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.compromis: Onogada besiteleka baphambukisa ithrafikhi kude nendawo yakho yokuphephela (-1 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.failure: Ama-Nyalas e-SAPS ahlakaza umugqa wokuvikela ngama-stun grenades ngaphambi kokuthi umgoqo ubambe.
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.title: Faka i-Section 205 Offshore Subpoena
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.desc: Sebenza nabaholi bobufakazi baka-Colonel van der Merwe ukuphoqa amabhange ukuthi adalule i-Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.clean: IJaji u-Khumalo lisayina i-oda. Isikhulu sokuthobela sasebhange silayisha ukudluliselwa kwemali kungakapheli ihora (+2 Trust, -1 Contempt).
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.compromi: Ummeli wokuzivikela ufaka izicelo eziphuthumayo, kodwa uthola ikhasi eliyinhloko elisayiniwe (+1 Trust).
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.failure: Ummeli ka-Mokoena ukusola ngokwakha ubufakazi enkantolo (+1 Contempt Warrant).
slot.slot_recess_debrief.title: Witness Protection Safe-Room Debrief (R300)
slot.slot_recess_debrief.desc: Thatha ikhofi futhi uhlanze izibopho emakamelweni aqinile e-Hawks ngaphansi kwe-Courtroom A ukuze uzole.
slot.slot_recess_debrief.clean: Constable Nandi—manje ohamba ngezinduku—ubuyekeza isikhathi sakho phezu kwetiye le-rooibos (+25% Composure, -1 Contempt).
slot.slot_recess_debrief.compromised: Amahora amabili okungalali ngemuva kwengilazi engangenwa zinhlamvu kubuyisela ukugxila kwakho (+15% Composure).
slot.slot_recess_debrief.failure: Izintatheli zishaya iminyango yegumbi ntambama yonke, kukushiya uphumule kancane (+5% Composure).
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.title: Ngena kwi-Packhouse B Synthesis Vats
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.desc: Dlula izinja ukuze uthathe izithombe zamathangi amanzi kamasipala epompa izinto zokwakha kwi-packhouse yezithelo. I-Stage 6 icisha ucingo lukagesi (+2).
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.clean: Ngaphansi kwesembozo sobumnyama uthatha izithombe zomugqa wonke wokuhlanganisa futhi ufaka u-R900 wamabhondi epokothweni kusuka kwi-safe yomphathi.
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.compromis: Uthola izinombolo ze-batch, kodwa izibani ziyavuleka njengoba ama-Rottweiler eshaya ucingo.
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.failure: Abaqashi abahlomile bavula umlilo ngezibhamu ze-R5 besuka embhoshongweni. Ubaleka ngomsele wokunisela umanzi ngamakhemikhali.
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.title: [FINALE] Hlasela i-Midlands Super-Lab
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.desc: Hola onogada besiteleka noma iqembu le-Hawks ngqo kwi-Packhouse B ngaphambi kokuthi ubufakazi bushise.
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.clean: Uphula amasango e-packhouse futhi uthatha incwadi enkulu—uphoqa u-Zuko no-Mokoena ukuba babaleke ngokushesha baya e-Hangar 7!
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.compromised: Ngaphansi kwesibhamu esinzima uthola ama-vats njengoba i-convoy yama-syndicate igijima iya e-King Shaka Airport!
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.failure: I-packhouse iyasha, kubangele ukungqubuzana kokugcina e-King Shaka Hangar 7!
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.title: Khiya i-Gulfstream ZS-900 Avionics
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.desc: Dlula i-radar transponder yase-hangar ukuze umise uhlelo lwendiza ka-Zuko lokuya e-Dubai. I-Stage 6 icisha i-radar yase-tarmac (+2).
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.clean: Ufaka iphutha lamanga lomlilo wenjini kukhompyutha yendiza ka-ZS-900, ubambezela imvume yokundiza (-1 Flight Countdown, -1 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.compromis: I-Air Traffic Control ibambe indiza leyo ethengiwe esangweni le-taxiway (-1 Flight Countdown).
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.failure: Baqaphi be-SAPS TRT abasophahleni lwe-hangar babone umkhondo wakho welaser ngaphesheya kwetiyela elimanzi.
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.title: [FINALE] Vimba indiza i-ZS-900 e-Hangar 7
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.desc: Shayela ungene etiyeleni elishaywa yimvula njengoba u-Zuko Ndlovu, u-Councillor Ma-Sibi, kanye no-Brigadier Mokoena bagibela i-Gulfstream.
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.clean: Izibani zemoto yakho zikhanyise isondo langaphambili le-Gulfstream—uvimba indlela yokuphuma ukuze kube nokubalwa kwezimali kokugcina!
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.compromised: Uphahlaze umgoqo we-Hangar 7 njengoba injini yendiza isiqala ukujikeleza!
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.failure: Uthola inhlamvu kubantu abaphelezela u-Mokoena, ushelela ungena etiyeleni njengoba izitebhisi zokugibela ziqala ukubuyela emuva!
clock.cartel_hit_squad.desc: U-Zuko no-Brigadier Mokoena baqashe izigebengu ezingaphandle kwesifundazwe ukuze bakuthulise ngaphambi kokuba iKhomishini iphothule.
clock.commission_subpoena.title: I-Contempt & Security Warrant
clock.commission_subpoena.desc: Abashushisi abakhohlakele ngaphakathi kophenyo bakha incwadi yokubopha ukuze bakubambe ngaphansi kwemithetho ye-State Security.
clock.trace_offshore_trust.title: Landelela i-Sovereign Pearl Trust
clock.trace_offshore_trust.desc: Hlanganisa amarejista ezinkampani zase-Umhlanga Ridge kanye nezincwadi zeNkantolo eNkulu ukuze uveze abanikazi base-Dubai.
clock.compile_ballistics_file.title: Hlanganisa i-Super-Lab Telemetry
clock.compile_ballistics_file.desc: Khipha amarekhodi emizila ye-GPS emalolini amanzi ase-Northern Township ukuze uthole indawo yokukhiqiza amakhemikhali.
clock.tarmac_extraction_countdown.title: Ukuhamba kwendiza i-ZS-900
clock.tarmac_extraction_countdown.desc: Isikhathi esisele ngaphambi kokuba u-Zuko Ndlovu, Ma-Sibi, no-Mokoena bagibele i-Gulfstream eya e-Dubai e-King Shaka Hangar 7.
dialogue.n1_safehouse.name: Constable Nandi
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p1: "Ungavuli amakhethini, Sbu. Ama-Golf GTI ka-Mokoena angabhalwanga azungeza i-Anton Lembede Street njalo ngemizuzu engamashumi amabili. Abazange babulale nje u-Auditor Sithole e-Umgeni weighbridge—babemlindile kanti ama-transponder etheku asevele ehlanzwe."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p2: "Konke u-Sithole afela khona kuse-Docket #409 nakuleyo foni ephukile. Ngitshele ukuthi asifi kuleli fulethi ngalobu busuku."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ask_ambush.label: "Ngichazele futhi ngokuhlaselwa e-N2 weighbridge. Ubani odonse isibhamu?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Bheka lezi zikhathi ze-weighbridge nami. Yimaphi amapuleti emaloli abebukeka njengemimoya?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_show_ledger.label: [Present Evidence: Decoded Water-Tanker Ledger] "Ngiwatholile amaphepha enkampani. U-Ma-Sibi no-Zuko bangabanikazi bamaloli."
dialogue_resp.nandi_exit.label: "Phumula, Nandi. Gcina umnyango uvaliwe ngenkathi ngisebenza emgwaqweni."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p1: "Izimoto ezimbili ezinezibani eziluhlaza zisivimbele ngemva nje kwe-Umgeni off-ramp. U-Brigadier Mokoena akazange agqoke ngisho imaski. Uphume egqoke izingubo zakhe ze-TRT, wabheka isikhwama sika-Sithole, watshela i-corporal yakhe ukuthi ishise imoto."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p2: "Ngingene emgodini wamanzi ngiphethe ifayela langempela ngaphansi kwesikibha sami. Uma u-Sparks e-Golden Dragon engakwazi ukuvula ifoni ka-Sithole, izwi lika-Mokoena likuleyo nothi yezwi."
dialogue_resp.nandi_back_root.label: "Asibuyele ezinkethweni zethu."
dialogue_resp.nandi_leave_ambush.label: "Ngiyaqinisekisa ukuthi leyo nothi yezwi iyaphuma."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.dockets_breakthrou: "Nanka—amapuleti ND-449-102 kuya ku-118. Bakhokhise i-City Hall izigidi ezingamashumi amane nambili zamaRandi ukuze balethe amanzi okuphuza e-KwaMashu ngesikhathi somgogodla, kodwa bheka ama-toll tags. Abazange baphendukele enyakatho."
"Lonke iloli lishayele laqonda e-Pier 2 Cold Storage ngo-01:30 ekuseni. Bathutha amakhemikhali ka-Zuko Ndlovu ngaphansi kwemvume yamanzi kamasipala."
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_back.label: "Lokho kungisindisa amahora okuhlola amaphepha. Bamba kancane."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p1: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics... amaphesenti angamashumi ayisithupha e-Abasanta Maritime, amaphesenti angamashumi amane e-trust yomndeni ka-Ma-Sibi. Ukufezile ngempela, Sbu."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p2: "Yisa lokhu ku-Colonel van der Merwe e-Old Archive Basement—noma ushise i-Berth 14 wena ngokwakho. Noma yikuphi, ngeke baphume bengajezisiwe."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ledger_back.label: "Ungazikhandzi. Sisekupheleni komdlalo."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.role: Queen Street Taxi Boss • Syndicate Fixer
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p1: "Hawu, owayengu-Hawk uhamba e-Queen Street ngenkathi abafana baka-Mokoena be-TRT bephenya yonke imikhumbi e-Warwick Junction. Unesibindi, Sbu, ngiyakuvuma lokho."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p2: "Akukho okuhambayo e-CBD ngaphandle kokuba abashayeli bami bakubone kuqala—hhayi ama-SAPS Nyalas, futhi nakanjani hhayi lawo maloli amanzi kamasipala agcwele kakhulu ekuseni kakhulu."
dialogue_resp.bheki_ask_tankers.label: "Abashayeli bakho basebusuku bathini ngamaloli amanzi kamasipala?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_street_check.label: [STREET >= 2] "Abaphathi bakho base-Berea bangesikweleti. Susa amapuleti ami kubabukeli baka-Mokoena."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rep_stipend.label: [Street Syndicate Rep >= 2] "Umanyano lwase-Queen Street luma ndawonye. Ingabe isikhungo singangisiza ngemali yokusebenza?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_exit.label: "Gcina izibani zakho ziphansi, Bra Bheki."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p1: "Lalela ngokucophelela. Lawo maloli anezimpawu ze-City Hall eminyango, akunjalo? Kodwa abafana bami abasebenza e-Umbilo bathi amasondo acindezelwe isisindo samagubu amakhemikhali, kanti izigebengu zase-Abasanta zihamba ngezimoto ze-Golf R."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p2: "Ngesikhathi omama bethu e-KwaMashu belayini ngamabhakede epulasitiki emapompini omile. U-Councillor Ma-Sibi uthengisa izindawo zakhe."
dialogue_resp.bheki_back.label: "Ulwazi oluhle. Asikhulume ngokunye."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.street_favor.p1: "Awukaze ukhohlwe ukuthi umgwaqo usebenza kanjani, Sbu. Kwenziwe. Ama-Quantum ami amathathu avimbele imoto yamakhamera e-SAPS e-Monty Naicker Road. Unendawo yokuphefumula."
dialogue_resp.bheki_favor_back.label: "Inhlonipho, Bra Bheki."
"Thatha lokhu esikhwameni sempi yomzila. Thenga udizili, nika umabhalane imali, noma usize u-Nandi alulame. Qiniseka nje ukuthi u-Mokoena uyopha ngokuminyanisa imigwaqo yethu."
dialogue_resp.bheki_stipend_back.label: "Lokhu kuzoya ngqo ekubhidlizeni umkhumbi wabo."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p1: "Hawu, hawul. Bheka kutsi yini leletfwe yimvula ehhovisi lami. Ukhishiwe emsebentini kuma-Hawks, Sbu—kungenela lapha kusho kutsi ufuna kufa nobe unemmeli lobiza kakhulu."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p2: "Uphi Constable Nandi, futsi uphi sikhwama semali semcwaningi mabhuku wamasipala?"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_bluff.label: "Ngimane ngihlola luhla lwemacala, Brigadier. Uyesaba yini ngalokutsite ku-N2?"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_influence_check.la: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "Internal Affairs ePitoli sebanayo ikhophi ye-Docket #409. Yekela lokukuhlela kwakho nobe sobabili sitawushiswa."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_present_manifest.l: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Ngelivi lakho kurekhodiwe utjela bantfu kutsi babulale e-Umgeni, Titus. Ngikhokhele kutsi ngilahle lelikhophi."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_exit.label: "Lala kahle, Brigadier. Qaphela lapho uhamba khona ebumnyameni."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_thr: "eThekwini isebenza ngemyalelo, Sbu. Zuko ugcina emachweba ethulile, Ma-Sibi ugcina emalambu avutsiwe eCity Hall, futsi i-Task Force yami igcina kuthula. Mandla Sithole ucabange kutsi iphepha lingamisa sitimela."
"Niketa Nandi ngaphambi kwemibili ebusuku ngelilanga lesine, nobe emadvodza ami angeke ahlupheke ngokungqongqoza emnyango wakho e-Mercury Arcade."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_threat_back.label: "Bamba lowo mcabango, Titus."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sta: "...Yekelani Car 4 na Car 7 eVictoria Embankment. Bewuhlale wati kutsi udlalwa njani umdlalo webureaucracy, Sbu. Jabulela lamahora langema-24 lengetiwe—angeke akusindise nase Berth 14 isisuliwe."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sha: "Ngako-ke i-Hawk le-idealistic ekugcineni ifundze intengo yenyama eThekwini. Tsatsa lemali lebanjiwe kulokhi. Gcina lelo fayela lemsindo kude netafula laColonel van der Merwe, mhlawumbe Zuko utakuvumela kutsi uphile uze ubone liviki lelitako."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_shakedown_back.lab: "Sitawubona kutsi sikweleti sakho sihlala sikhatsi lesingakanani."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p1: "Vala umnyango, sithandwa, umswakama wonakalisa i-mahogany. Wonkhe umuntfu kulelidolobha uyakhala nase kucishiwe emandla e-Stage 6, kodvwa kute lobuta kutsi ngubani lokhokhela tipolitiki talemifelandawonye."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p2: "Ube uhogela kule-Procurement Registry B. Ngitjele kutsi umphenyi losuswe emsebentini ufuna ini nengcondvo yemanti lesimo lesiphutfumako."
dialogue_resp.masibi_ask_grid.label: "Kungani i-Sub-Station 14 ihlale icisha nase Pier 2 yethula imphahla phakatsi ebusuku?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_present_ledger.labe: [Present Evidence: Decoded Water-Tanker Ledger] "Emashumi lamane emaphesenti e-Zululand Aqua-Logistics angawemndeni wakho, Ma-Sibi."
dialogue_resp.masibi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Umfana wakho ushiye luhlelo lwe-Sub-Station 14 override kumshini we-fax. Ngikopisha sikhatsi sekucima kwemachweba."
dialogue_resp.masibi_exit.label: "Jabulela i-air-conditioning nase isasebenta, Councillor."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p1: "Load shedding yinhlekelele, Sbu—ngaphandle uma wati kutsi ngumuphi umshini lokufanele uwucishe nini. Nase Stage 6 ishaya i-Point Waterfront, emakhamera e-Transnet ayaba yimpumputhe emamahora lamane."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p2: "Bangani be-City Hall abahlali ebumnyameni. Titsa titfola tindlu tato tihlaselwe ngaphambi kwekutsi emalambu emgwaqo abuye."
dialogue_resp.masibi_grid_back.label: "Luhlelo lolulula."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p1: "Mandla Sithole bekangumcwaningi mabhuku lohlakaniphile kodvwa abete likhono lekuhlala aphila. Wena, ngakolunye luhlangotsi, uyaweva lamandla."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p2: "Nansi imali le-five-hundred Rand kusuka esikhwameni sesigodzi. Gcina ligama lami kude emaphephandzabeni, futsi lihhovisi lami lingaze lilawule i-Eskom grid nase udinga kucishwa kwemandla."
dialogue_resp.masibi_leverage_back.label: "Ngizoyifaka imali. Sitawubona ngemaphephandzaba."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.dockets_fax.p1: "Bantfu labanekhono kunzima kubatfola kulemasipala. Kulungile—tsatsa leli-telecoms routing sheet. Utakutfola kutsi iholela ngco ku-crane yaZuko e-Berth 14."
dialogue_resp.masibi_fax_back.label: "Siyabonga kakhulu, Councillor."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.name: Sparks
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p1: "Qaphela i-tripwire eceleni kwesitendi semvula, Sbu! I-Stage 4 voltage spikes isishise emashini ami lamabili, futsi emaphoyisa e-cyber-crime kaMokoena abesehlola yonkhe imibhoshongo yemakhalekhukhwini emkhatsini we-Grey Street ne-harbour."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p2: "Ulethe le-GraphemeOS brick yaMandla Sithole? Lelo foni linayo i-Abasanta remote-wipe daemon lehlala ku-baseband chip."
dialogue_resp.sparks_ask_phone.label: "Yini leku-foni yemcwaningi mabhuku lekwenta Zuko na Mokoena besabe kangaka?"
dialogue_resp.sparks_wire_check.label: [WIRE >= 2] "Asihlanganise emaphini e-JTAG ngaphakatsi kwe-Faraday cage ngaphambi kwekutsi i-baseband ikhombise emabhoshongo."
dialogue_resp.sparks_coffee_stim.label: [Pay R100] "Beka imbita ye-Ethiopian espresso esitofini futsi uhlole ifoni yami yebunyameni kute uthole i-SAPS IMSI-catchers."
dialogue_resp.sparks_exit.label: "Gcina i-Faraday cage ivaliwe, Sparks."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p1: "Sithole bekangasiye nje umcwaningi mabhuku—ufake imakrofoni e-Pier 2 Cold Storage. Ngaphambi kwekutsi bashayise imoto yakhe ku-N2, ifoni yakhe ibe irekhode imiyalezo yelivi yemasekhondi langema-48 kanye ne-manifest ye-container ye-MV Southern Cross."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p2: "Qaphela i-Stage 6 blackouts, noma kunjalo. Ngaphandle uma usebentisa i-generator yakho ye-diesel, umshini wami we-decryption uyacima."
dialogue_resp.sparks_lore_back.label: "Kuhle kwati. Asihlole letafula."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.wire_collab.p1: "Ayoba! Bheka leso sikhatsi se-voltage—siphumelele kudlula i-biometric lock yekucala ngaphandle kwekucalisa i-Abasanta wipe daemon. Kancane nje futsi le-drive ingeyakho."
dialogue_resp.sparks_collab_back.label: "Kuhle kusebentisa i-soldering, Sparks."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.imsi_sweep.p1: "Yup, Central Precinct ibe ne-stingray tower levaleleke ku-SIM serial yakho yakadzeni. Sengishintje i-baseband MAC address yakho kutsi ibukeke njengemshini wekupaka wamasipala. Phuza!"
dialogue_resp.sparks_imsi_back.label: "Lokho kumnandi."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p1: "Bheka emfuleni, Sbu. Imikhumbi lengema-60 ilindze, emakhulu lamatsatfu emacontainer ngelilanga, futsi iPitoli icabanga kutsi liphepha lelisayinwe ngumantji lilawula lelichweba."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p2: "Ngakhe i-Abasanta Logistics kusuka esakhiweni sinye. Nyalo umi e-catwalk yami unelibhuku lemcwaningi mabhuku lofile. Ute lapha kutsi utodlala iqhawe, nobe ute lapha kutsi ucondze lokufunwa nalokuniketwako?"
dialogue_resp.zuko_philosophy.label: "Ubutisa emanti emalokishi kute uthuthe imitsi yemakhemikhali, Zuko."
dialogue_resp.zuko_present_manifest.labe: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Container MSCU-908114 ufake uphawu. Ngifake esabelweni se-logistics noma ama-Hawks azohlasela i-MV Southern Cross."
dialogue_resp.zuko_street_spot.label: [STREET >= 2] "Onogada bakho base-Berth 14 bashintshe amashifu. Sengivele ngibonile ukuthi kukuphi lapho bengaboni khona eduze kwama-valve kaphethiloli."
dialogue_resp.zuko_exit.label: "Sizokulungisa lokhu uma umkhumbi waphakathi kwamabili usuhamba, Zuko."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p1: "I-City Hall yebi imali yamanzi eminyakeni eyishumi ngaphambi kokuba ngiqashe i-tanker, Sbu. Ngivele ngaqasha amaloli abo angenalutho. Kuleli lizwe, ingqalasizinda ingeyalowo ogcina i-diesel futhi okhokhela onogada."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p2: "Mokoena uyisigebengu esingacabangi, kanti Ma-Sibi uyisikhwabanisi. Ngisize usule i-Berth 14 ebusuku, ngeke usaphinde uzabalaze ngemali yerenti e-Mercury Arcade."
dialogue_resp.zuko_vision_back.label: "Wonke umholi wezigebengu ucabanga ukuthi uyisazi sefilosofi."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_deal.p1: "Indoda ehlakaniphile. Ama-Hawks akukhokhele kancane akulahla ezingonyameni ngesikhathi usondela eqinisweni. Thatha lokhu njengesabelo sakho sokuqala esivela e-Berth 14. Uma kufika phakathi kwamabili, qinisekisa ukuthi lowo mkhumbi uyahamba."
dialogue_resp.zuko_deal_back.label: "Sizobona ukuthi phakathi kwamabili kuletheni."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_respect.p1: "Akumangalisi ukuthi ithimba lababulali bakaMokoena likuphuthele ku-N2. Uhamba njengentuthu yasechwebeni. Tshela uTitus ukuthi ngibabizile onogada bakhe basechwebeni ebusuku—uma sizohlola amandla omunye nomunye, akukwenzi lokho ngaphandle kwabantu abangazi lutho endleleni."
dialogue_resp.zuko_respect_back.label: "Kuze kube phakathi kwamabili e-Berth 14."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.role: DPCI Hawks Holdout • Clean Task Force
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p1: "Udlule kumakhamera enkantolo kamantshi, Sbu. Kuhle. Ingxenye yeProvincial Headquarters isemholweni kaMokoena, yingakho ngithuthele ithimba lami lapha ngezansi nemishini ye-microfiche yama-1980."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p2: "Ubuka sengathi usenkingeni, mfana wami—futhi ngizwile ukuthi uConstable Nandi udutshuliwe ku-N2. Ngitshele ukuthi ulethe okuthile okungamelana nejaji le-High Court."
dialogue_resp.vdm_ask_hawks.label: "Kungani ama-Hawks engakabophi uMokoena noMa-Sibi, Colonel?"
dialogue_resp.vdm_present_both.label: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Lalela leli fayela lomsindo, Colonel. U-Mokoena uyena owalela ukuhlaselwa ku-N2."
dialogue_resp.vdm_exit.label: "Gcina umnyango wensimbi uvaliwe, Colonel. Sengicishe ngalunga."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_politic: "Ngoba njalo uma ngibhala i-warrant e-Upstairs, othile eMnyangweni uyaxwayisa i-City Hall emizuzwini eyishumi nanhlanu. Ngaphandle kwencwadi yezimali KANYE nomsindo we-Berth 14, umshushisi uzolahla icala ngaphambi kwesidlo sasekuseni."
"Uma sithumela lonke iphakethe ngqo egumbini lezindaba le-The Daily Veld ngenkathi sivikela uNandi, abakwazi ukukufihla."
dialogue_resp.vdm_politics_back.label: "Khona-ke sizodlula e-Upstairs ngokuphelele."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_audio_s: "Nkulunkulu wami... 'thatha imoto yakhe ngaphambi kwe-off-ramp yase-Umgeni bese ushisa isikhwama.' Lelo yizwi likaTitus Mokoena, lizwakala kahle."
"Ngibeka imoto yakho kurejista yethu yezokuxhumana yombuso manje ukuze usule i-Precinct Heat yakho. Hlala uphila kuze kube sikhuluma lokhu, Sbu."
dialogue_resp.vdm_audio_back.label: "Ngiyabonga, Colonel."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p1: "Umoya uhlanzekile lapha e-Ridge, akunjalo, Sbu? Ezansi e-CBD babambe imihlangano yabo encane yophenyo, bezenza sengathi ijaji elithathile umhlalaphansi lingalungisa iminyaka engamashumi amabili yokukhwabanisa komasipala."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p2: "Izikhwama zami sezivele zise-King Shaka Hangar 7. Kungani ukhwela embhoshongweni wami wengilazi kanti isiphepho sesiphelile?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_trust.label: "Iyini i-Sovereign Pearl Holdings, futhi kungani i-Gulfstream igcwaliswe uphethiloli e-Hangar 7?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_wire.label: [WIRE >= 2] "Umfana wakho wezimali ukhohlwe ukusula i-Dubai SWIFT mirror kuseva yaphansi yesi-28."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_deed.label: [Present Evidence: Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed] "Nginohlelo lobunikazi, Ma-Sibi. Thenga indawo yakho ngaphandle kohlu lwami lwezinsolo."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_exit.label: "Ungayigibeli leyo Gulfstream okwamanje, Councillor."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_duba: "Wonke usopolitiki ohlakaniphile e-KwaZulu-Natal uyazi ukuthi i-Rand eyokuchitha kanti i-Dirham eyokugcina. I-Sovereign Pearl inezakhiwo e-Dubai, ipulazi lezithelo e-Midlands, nendiza eqashiwe e-Hangar 7."
"U-Zuko unamaphesenti angamashumi amane nanhlanu, mina nginamashumi amathathu, kanti uTitus Mokoena unamashumi amabili nanhlanu ngokugcina izibhamu zikude nathi."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_back.label: "Ukuhlukana okuhle kwabathathu."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_swif: "Uhacke i-escrow terminal? Uyaqhubeka ngempela. Kulungile—abashushisi abaphethe leyo Warrant yokudelela inkantolo abaphendula kwi-coalition yami. Ngizobatshela ukuthi bawubambezele umbiko wakho wokuboshwa."
dialogue_resp.masibi_swift_back.label: "Isinyathelo esihlakaniphile."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_act2: "Yithathe. Qondisa intukuthelo yakho e-lab kaZuko yase-Midlands noma kubabulali bakaMokoena—yeka owesifazane omdala aye ekhaya lakhe lokuphumula e-Palm Jumeirah."
dialogue_resp.masibi_payoff_back.label: "Sizobona ukuthi ubani ozohamba ngendiza."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n9_township_depot.role: Northern Water Strike Marshal • Queen St. Alliance
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p1: "Bheka lezi zimoto esizithathile izolo ebusuku, Sbu! Izindonga zamanga ezishiselwe ngaphakathi—zomile njengamathambo endaweni yamanzi, kanti kunezinsalela zamakhemikhali emnyombweni ofihliwe."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p2: "Abantu basezindaweni ezisenyakatho sebakhathele ukulinda amakhomishini e-High Court. Abashayeli bami bavale indawo, kanti izinkabi zikaMokoena ezivela ngaphandle kwesifundazwe zizulazula emigwaqweni yase-ridge zikufuna."
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_gps.label: "Ingabe amaloli aboshiwe abesenawo ama-GPS transponders awo?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_street.label: [STREET >= 2] "Masikhiphe ama-GPS flash chips elolini eliyinhloko #14 manje bese sibeka abantu abazobuka lelo thimba lababulali."
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_exit.label: "Bamba amasango endawo, Bra Bheki. Siyohlasela esakhiweni sabo."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_gps_inf: "Wonke! Phakathi kuka-1:00 AM no-4:00 AM, esikhundleni sokukhipha amanzi edamu, lawa maloli akhuphukele ku-N3 eya epulazini lezithelo eduze kwe-Howick spur."
"Hlanganisa leyo datha, Sbu, uzoba nezindawo eziqondile ze-super-lab kaZuko."
dialogue_resp.bheki_gps_back.label: "Lokho yisixhumanisi esilahlekile phakathi kwechweba nesikhumulo sezindiza."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_street_: "Nansi i-flash module evela elolini #14! Futhi ungakhathazeki ngalabo babulali abaqashiwe base-Joburg—noma iyiphi imoto engajwayelekile engena endleleni esenyakatho izovinjwa ngama-Quantum angamashumi amane ngaphambi kokuba bakwazi ukulayisha isibhamu."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rally_back.label: "Amandla, Bra Bheki."
dialogue.n10_high_court.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p1: "Siyakwamukela eKhomishini Yophenyo, Sbu. I-Berth 14 yembule konke okwakwenzeka ethekwini, ngakho-ke manje leli qembu lezigebengu lisilwa nathi ngabameli abagqoke kahle kanye nemiyalo yokuvalwa kwemilomo evela ku-State Security."
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p2: "Okubi kakhulu, sithole imininingwane yendiza evela e-King Shaka International. Indiza i-ZS-900—i-Gulfstream yangasese—igcwaliswa uphethiloli e-Hangar 7 ukuze ikhiphe u-Zuko, u-Ma-Sibi, no-Mokoena baye e-Dubai."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_plan.label: "Yini esiyidingayo ukuze simise indiza i-ZS-900 futhi sibaqede unomphela?"
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_dockets.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Masifake isicelo esiphuthumayo manje ukuze sichithe i-Contempt Warrant futhi sibize amarekhodi e-escrow ase-Ridge."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_exit.label: "Qhubeka neKhomishini, Colonel. Mina ngiyozingela."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_act2_briefin: "Imiboniso emibili ebalulekile: Okokuqala, i-Sovereign Pearl Offshore Trust Deed evela kuma-penthouse ase-Ridge efakazela ukuthi bobathathu bangabanikazi bale nkampani yezigebengu. Okwesibili, i-Midlands Super-Lab Batch Telemetry evela emalolini amanzi asenyakatho."
"Vula noma yikuphi kwalokhu ukuze wembule i-Citrus Estate kanye ne-King Shaka Hangar 7—noma uvikele kokubili uma ufuna ukubafaka bonke ezinketheni khona lapho ethamaki."
dialogue_resp.vdm_briefing_back.label: "Ngizwile, Colonel."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_dockets_moti: "Isicelo esihle kakhulu, Sbu. Lokho kubopha izandla zabashushisi baka-Ma-Sibi abakhohlakele amahora angamashumi amane nesishiyagalombili, futhi kuphoqa unobhala wenkampani yase-Ridge ukuthi avule i-ledger ye-DIFC."
dialogue_resp.vdm_motion_back.label: "Masisebenzise leli thuba."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p1: "Ulandele amaloli amanzi uze ufike phezulu entabeni, Sbu. Kuyamangaza. Iningi labantu liyayeka uma lifika kuma-penthouse ase-Umhlanga."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p2: "Bheka nxazonke e-Packhouse B. Amawolintshi ase-Valencia aphezulu, kanti ngezansi kunemithi yokudakamizwa ehlanzekile, elungele ukuthunyelwa e-King Shaka Cargo Apron. Futhi umi phakathi nendawo yokuvuna kwami."
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_why.label: "Ubalekela e-Dubai ngendiza i-ZS-900 ebusuku. Ingabe u-Architect uyethuka?"
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_present_telemetr: [Present Evidence: Super-Lab Telemetry] "Yonke inombolo yebhatchi nomzila wamaloli usuvele ukhona kwenye indawo. Yekisa iqembu lakho lezinkabi futhi ukhokhe intela yokuhamba."
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_exit.label: "Sizobonana ethamaki e-Hangar 7, Zuko."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_man: "Ngiyethuka? Cha, Sbu—ngiyashintsha. I-Khomishini Yophenyo idinga umdlalo, ngakho u-Ma-Sibi no-Mokoena bayethuka. Ngenkathi thina, ingqalasizinda esiyakhile lapha ikhiqiza izigidi ezingamashumi amabili zama-Euro ngenyanga."

"Uma ufika e-Hangar 7 ebusuku, uzoba nokukhetha: usibophele uhulumeni ozosithatha indawo ngoLwesibili, ushise le ndawo neqembu lika-Bra Bheki, noma uthathe izihluthulelo zesihlalo sobukhosi wena ngokwakho."
dialogue_resp.zuko_manifesto_back.label: "Sizokwenza lokho kukhetha e-Hangar 7."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_tru: "Abadubuli base-Gauteng bayayeka. Uzitholele indawo etafuleni, Sbu. Thatha lokhu e-safe yase-packhouse—futhi ucabange kahle ngaphambi kokuba uvumele u-Colonel van der Merwe afake izinketheni esikhathini esizayo."
dialogue_resp.zuko_truce_back.label: "Sizobonana esikhumulweni sezindiza."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena

tutorial.step1.title: Step 1: Daily Action Dice & Kuthula Kwengcondvo
tutorial.step1.desc: At dawn each Umjikeleto (Day), your investigator rolls a pool of 3 to 5 six-sided dice based on current Kuthula Kwengcondvo (80–100% = 5 dice, 40–79% = 4 dice, <40% = 3 dice). Kuthula Kwengcondvo is your mental stamina and resilience against Durban's underworld.
tutorial.step2.title: Step 2: Assigning Dice to Action Slots
tutorial.step2.desc: Hold or click a die from your bottom dock, then click an Action Slot on any unlocked map node. Rolls resolve deterministically: Die Value + Stat Modifier + Stage 6 Kucima Kwagezi Modifier + Hostile Turf Penalty. Tiers preview cleanly: 6+ Hlantekile Kuphumelela, 4–5 Compromised, 1–3 Kwehluleka.
tutorial.step3.title: Step 3: Rolling Blackouts (Load Shedding)
tutorial.step3.desc: Eskom power rotates across Stages 2 -> 4 -> 6 -> 2 each night. During Stage 6 Blackouts, high-tech server slots lock down unless you spend R300 on Backup Generator Diesel, but covert operations at the Port and Estates gain a +2 Roll Bonus under cover of darkness.
tutorial.step4.title: Step 4: Threat & Investigation Clocks
tutorial.step4.desc: Circular segmented clocks tick down impending catastrophes (Brigadier Mokoena's Kushanyela Kwesikhatsi, Nandi's Inkhwelombhalo Yelinxeba, Izinkabi Hit Squads) and track your forensic breakthroughs (Idokhethi #409 Kuhlolwa Kwemabhuku, Phone Cracking, Berth 14 Convoy). When investigation clocks fill, climactic finale showdowns unlock.
tutorial.step5.title: Step 5: Roadblocks & Faction Perks
tutorial.step5.desc: High Siteshi Semaphoyisa Heat or Threat levels trigger armed SAPS roadblock corridors between sectors. Crossing them burns 1 Die or R200 in cold drink bribes unless you possess a cloned SAPS scanner. Earn positive Faction Rep to unlock 1/day tactical abilities like Grid Manipulation and Blue-Light Escorts.
tutorial.step6.title: Step 6: Contacts, Evidence & Red-String Board
tutorial.step6.desc: Speak with local fixers and faction bosses at each node to interrogate leads, present forensic exhibits, and claim one-time favors. Press 'B' or tap 'BOARD' anytime to inspect your red-string conspiracy corkboard, tracing the money trail from City Hall to Berth 14.
