ending.ending_vigilante.pathLabel: THE Umlweli Wetemfundvo PATH // BLOOD ON THE BREAKWATER
ending.ending_vigilante.p1: When Stage 6 kills the Lichweba Lemikhumbi floodlights at midnight, Bra Bheki’s minibus convoy cuts its headlights and blocks the Pier 2 weighbridge. Fifteen heavily armed izinkabi step out from behind the rusting container stacks just as Brigadier Mokoena’s unmarked TRT vans escort the municipal water tankers onto Berth 14.
ending.ending_vigilante.p2: The firefight echoes across the Natal Port Channel for twenty minutes. Punctured chemical drums spill across the wet asphalt, catching a tracer round and sending a wall of orange flame forty metres into the humid night sky.
ending.ending_vigilante.p3: In the chaos, you breach the lead armoured command van, haul out two steel cases of Abasanta bearer Imali Lasesandleni, and pull Constable Nandi into your getaway car before the port sirens even spin up.
ending.ending_vigilante.shift1.title: Abasanta Licembu Lebugebengu Crippled
ending.ending_vigilante.shift1.summary: R80 million in Mexican chemical precursors burn on the quay. Zuko Ndlovu retreats to his inland citrus estates, vowing to purge the port security directorate.
ending.ending_vigilante.shift2.title: Queen Street Ascendant
ending.ending_vigilante.shift2.summary: Bra Bheki’s Umhlangano Webugebengu seizes control of the Umgeni transport corridor, forcing City Hall to pay his 30% forum cut on every tanker truck.
ending.ending_vigilante.shift3.title: The Ghost of Mercury Arcade
ending.ending_vigilante.shift3.summary: With R450,000 in stolen Licembu Lebugebengu Imali Lasesandleni funding your off-grid clinic and armoury, you become the CBD’s untouchable shadow fixer.
ending.ending_whistleblower.pathLabel: THE Umbhali Wemaciniso PATH // TRUTH IN THE DARK
ending.ending_whistleblower.p1: At 04:00 AM, Colonel Piet van der Merwe’s loyal Hawks task force seals the steel blast doors of the Old Ingobo Yemlando Likamelo Lelingaphansi. While Constable Nandi is smuggled onto a light aircraft bound for a witness-protection safe farm in the Drakensberg, you upload the decrypted Berth 14 audio and the audited Zululand Aqua-Logistics ledgers to every independent newsroom in the country.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p2: By sunrise, Brigadier Mokoena’s voice—ordering the execution of the municipal auditor and clearing the N2 weighbridge for Zuko’s chemical tankers—is playing on every taxi radio and morning news bulletin from Durban to Johannesburg.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p3: Outside City Hall, thousands of residents whose taps have been dry for months flood the streets, surrounding Councillor Ma-Sibi’s motorcade.
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift1.title: City Hall in Freefall
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift1.summa: National Treasury freezes the R400m water-tanker contract by noon. Ma-Sibi’s Chief of Staff is arrested at King Shaka International Airport trying to board a flight to Dubai.
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift2.title: SAPS Internal Purge
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift2.summa: IPID and the Hawks raid Central Siteshi Semaphoyisa’s 13th Floor. Brigadier Mokoena goes underground with a rogue detachment of loyal TRT officers.
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift3.title: Badge Restored, Target Painted
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift3.summa: Colonel van der Merwe reinstates your Warrant Officer credentials—but Abasanta’s Chemical Ghost hitmen have just placed a R5 million bounty on your badge.
ending.ending_kingpin.pathLabel: THE KINGPIN PATH // THE GLASS HOUSE COMPACT
ending.ending_kingpin.p1: The private elevator to The Glass House rises above the rusted container cranes into air-conditioned silence. Zuko Ndlovu pours two glasses of single malt while Brigadier Mokoena and Councillor Ma-Sibi’s Chief of Staff watch you lay the bloodstained original pages of Idokhethi #409 and the auditor’s decrypted drive onto the glass table.
ending.ending_kingpin.p2: "Logistics is about removing friction," Zuko says softly, looking out over the darkened city grid. "You proved more capable than Brigadier Mokoena’s entire regiment. Name your tariff."
ending.ending_kingpin.p3: You strike the match yourself. As the original forensic annexures curl into ash, your suspension is wiped from the SAPS mainframe, Constable Nandi’s name is cleared with a quiet medical pension, and your newly registered consulting firm is awarded 20% of the Zululand Aqua-Logistics pipeline.
ending.ending_kingpin.shift1.title: The Umhlangano Webugebengu Consolidates
ending.ending_kingpin.shift1.summary: The Berth 14 precursor shipment rolls through the N2 weighbridge untouched under blue-light escort. The methamphetamine super-labs double their output.
ending.ending_kingpin.shift2.title: Hawks Task Force Shuttered
ending.ending_kingpin.shift2.summary: Without Idokhethi #409, Colonel van der Merwe’s inquiry collapses for lack of evidence. His Likamelo Lelingaphansi unit is reassigned to rural stock-theft duty.
ending.ending_kingpin.shift3.title: The New Fixer-General
ending.ending_kingpin.shift3.summary: You move out of the Mercury Arcade flat into a Ridge penthouse—wealthy, reinstated, and permanently chained to Zuko Ndlovu’s Libhuku Lemali.
ending.ending_captured.pathLabel: SYSTEMIC Kwehluleka // SWALLOWED BY THE GRID
ending.ending_captured.p1: Exhausted, broke, and boxed in by Operation Shanela roadblocks, your trail finally runs out in the rain-swept alleys behind Queen Street. When the grid drops to Stage 6, the streetlights die—and four unmarked TRT Volkswagen Golfs box you against the shuttered roller doors.
ending.ending_captured.p2: Brigadier Mokoena doesn’t read you your rights. He pulls Idokhethi #409 and the dead auditor’s phone from your coat pocket, checks the seal, and nods to Sergeant Dlamini.
ending.ending_captured.p3: By the time the morning commuters crowd the taxi rank, theMercury Arcade flat has been scrubbed Hlantekile, and another anonymous dossier has vanished into the furnace of eThekwini-Gold.
ending.ending_captured.shift1.title: State Capture Unchecked
ending.ending_captured.shift1.summary: Ma-Sibi wins the municipal coalition vote unopposed, expanding the emergency water-tanker contracts by another R600 million.
ending.ending_captured.shift2.title: Idokhethi #409 Erased
ending.ending_captured.shift2.summary: The N2 Imali Lasesandleni-in-Transit massacre is officially closed as an unsolved Umhlangano Webugebengu hijacking.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.pathLabel: ACT 2 FINALE // THE CONSTITUTIONAL Kujejiswa Kwemlandvo
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p1: As Gulfstream ZS-900 turns onto the active taxiway, four unmarked Hawks interceptors and a High Court sheriff’s van block the nose gear. You step out into the blinding sodium glare holding the certified Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed and the Midlands super-lab batch logs.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p2: Brigadier Mokoena reaches for his holster, but seeing twenty DPCI rifles trained on the airstairs—and a live broadcast camera streaming directly to the Commission’s emergency feed—he slowly lowers his weapon. Councillor Ma-Sibi and Zuko Ndlovu are led down the wet stairs in steel cuffs.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p3: By morning, the KwaZulu-Natal High Court places Zululand Aqua-Logistics under judicial administration, and the northern township reservoirs open to full pressure for the first time in a year.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift1.summ: Zuko Ndlovu, Councillor Ma-Sibi, and Brigadier Mokoena face 142 counts of racketeering, treasonous sabotage, and murder before a special High Court tribunal.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift2.summ: Forensic teams seize R1.2 billion in offshore escrow and dismantle the Howick hydroponic precursor plant.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift3.summ: Promoted to Major in the rebuilt DPCI Organised Crime Directorate, you and Constable Nandi take over the 13th Floor of Central Siteshi Semaphoyisa.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p1: Instead of waiting for slow court orders, you broadcast the Hangar 7 coordinates and the Sovereign Pearl escrow keys directly to Bra Bheki’s Queen Street marshals and the Northern Township strike committees.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p2: Within thirty minutes, three hundred minibus taxis and forty hijacked municipal water tankers smash through the cargo apron perimeter fence, surrounding Gulfstream ZS-900 on the runway. Zuko’s mercenaries drop their rifles and flee into the sugarcane fields.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p3: Before sunrise, the Umhlangano Webugebengu’s R400 million liquid escrow is wired directly into community water cooperatives, and a convoy of freshly flushed tankers rolls into KwaMashu with sirens blaring in celebration.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift1.sum: The Northern Township Water Forum seizes permanent control of the municipal tanker fleet, ending the artificial drought overnight.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift2.sum: Stripped of both their Licembu Lebugebengu protection and offshore slush funds, Ma-Sibi’s coalition resigns en masse amid citywide street celebrations.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift3.sum: Every minibus from Point Road to the Midlands carries your callsign on the rear window—the outlaw Hawk who gave the city back to its streets.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p1: You stand alone in the rain at Hangar 7 with your thumb on the encrypted broadcast switch. Zuko Ndlovu looks at the High Court subpoena in your left hand and the Dubai flight plan in your right, then smiles and signs the transfer of Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p2: At 00:05 AM, you call off the Hawks interceptors and watch Gulfstream ZS-900 climb into the storm clouds toward the Indian Ocean. Ten minutes later, Colonel van der Merwe receives a sanitized Idokhethi pinning the entire conspiracy on a dead deputy clerk.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p3: From the top floor of the Umhlanga Ridge glass tower, you watch Stage 6 plunge the city below into darkness—while your private turbines hum without a flicker.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.shift: With Zuko, Ma-Sibi, and Mokoena exiled in Dubai, you assume 100% control of Sovereign Pearl Holdings, the Lichweba Lemikhumbi cranes, and the Midlands estate.
The State Capture Inquiry releases a toothless 900-page report recommending "administrative reforms" with zero high-profile convictions.
You own the judges, the taxi ranks, and the municipal tenders. In eThekwini-Gold, midnight now belongs to you.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.pathLabel: ACT 2 Kwehluleka // REDACTED FROM THE RECORD
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p1: Arriving at Hangar 7 without certified proof of either the Sovereign Pearl trust or the Midlands batch telemetry leaves you exposed on the open tarmac. When Stage 6 cuts the airport perimeter lights, Brigadier Mokoena’s sniper team pins your vehicle behind a cargo loader.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p2: Gulfstream ZS-900 roars down the runway and lifts into the coastal clouds carrying every original Libhuku Lemali and witness out of South African jurisdiction.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p3: Three weeks later, the Commission of Inquiry closes its proceedings behind locked doors, sealing your uncorroborated testimony in the National Archives for fifty years.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.shift1.title: Hlantekile Getaway
ending.ending_act2_vanished.shift1.summa: Zuko Ndlovu and Ma-Sibi relocate their logistics empire to Dubai while retaining silent proxies inside City Hall.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.shift2.title: Case Closed
ending.ending_act2_vanished.shift2.summa: Without the Sovereign Pearl deed or Midlands telemetry, the High Court dismisses all remaining charges.

mission.faq_q2_title: 2. Ngitfola emadayisi lamangakhi? Ngabe ngiphosa emadayisi kuyo yonkhe indzawo?

AWUPHOSI emadayisi kuyo yonkhe indzawo! Ukhetsa tentfo letibalulekile leti-3 kuya ku-5 emephini kute usebentise emandla akho elilanga.
mission.faq_q3_body:
Kucindzetela u-Cedza Umjikelezo kuphetsa ishifu yakho futsi kudlulele ekuseni kwalelilanga lelilandelako:
• Emawashi eTinsongo laChubeka embili (+1 sigaba kumawashi labovu lasebentako).

mission.faq_q4_title: 4. Ngati kanjani kutsi ngumaphi emadayisi lasetjentisiwe nalawo lasasele?

Nangabe kuphuma kwengati kwa-Constable Nandi kushaya 4/4 ungakamcinisi, ufa unomphela eflethini lakho (-30% Composure). Nangabe i-Composure yakho ishaya 0%, ucala i-Blackout Paranoia!

intro.pitch_story2: Kupheliswa kwemachinga kwekuphehlwa kwegezi kwa-Eskom kute kuphocelelwe emathenda ladzingekako adizili, laxhaswe ngemali ngongxiwankulu betekuphepha kanye nebaphatsi labakhohlakele. Umcwaningi we-SIU uKagiso "Bra K" Molefe kumele angene emigodzini lejulile yaseGoli nasemakamelweni laseSandton ngaphambi kwekutsi gezi liwe.
intro.pitch_story3: Timvumo letingakabhaliswa tekumba emadayimane elwandle, kutfunyelwa kwetikhali emnceleni, kanye nemabutfo emikhumbi labucala labalungisa imali yemandla ibe ngematje etimphi tamhlaba wonkhe elugwini lwase-Atlantic lolunenkungu e-Port Nolloth nase-Richtersveld.
intro.pitch_story4: Umfelandzawonye lofihlakele wabojenene bamaphoyisa esifundza, emacembu ezigebengu lase-Cape Flats lahlangene, kanye nabosigwaca base-Winelands labahlomisa libutfo letekuphepha lelibucala kute balawule umnotfo wasebusuku kanye nematiko ekutfumela ngaphandle. Lomseshi wakadzala we-Anti-Gang Unit u-Leila Hendricks uphenya kusukela e-Camps Bay kuya etindzaweni teliwayini e-Stellenbosch.
intro.pitch_story5: Kuphela Lokuphelele Kwegezi Lesigaba 8 kuto tonkhe tifundza letiyimfica. Ithimba Lelihlangene Le-Hawks lihlanganisa tinhlavu letine letibalulekile tasesifundzeni kute lihhasele umhlangano wemgwaco we-Sovereign Octagon e-Drakensberg ngaphambi kwekutsi intsandvo yelinyenti ivalwe phakadze.
